snaps.d: 秦疆域达到顶峰（约前214—前210）。北面蒙恬率三十万众逐匈奴、取河南地，置九原郡，因河为塞，连接秦赵燕旧长城为万里长城，又自云阳修直道直抵九原；南面屠睢、任嚣、赵佗征百越，史禄凿灵渠通粮道，平定岭南，置南海、桂林、象郡。驰道通天下，六国间的内地长城与关塞“堕坏城郭……夷去险阻”，随之废弃。
snaps.de: Qin's territory reaches its greatest extent (c. 214–210 BC). In the north Meng Tian leads three hundred thousand men to drive out the Xiongnu and take Henandi, sets up Jiuyuan Commandery, uses the river as a barrier and joins the old long walls of Qin, Zhao and Yan into the Great Wall, and builds the Straight Road from Yunyang to Jiuyuan; in the south Tu Sui, Ren Xiao and Zhao Tuo campaign against the Hundred Yue, the supervising censor Lu cuts the Lingqu Canal as a supply route, Lingnan is pacified, and the Nanhai, Guilin and Xiang commanderies are set up. The imperial highways reach across the realm, and the interior long walls and forts between the six states are torn down ("pulling down city walls … levelling strongholds") and abandoned.

snaps.d: 前210 年七月始皇崩于沙丘，赵高、李斯矫诏赐死扶苏，立胡亥为二世，蒙恬被逼自杀。二世元年七月，戍卒陈胜、吴广屯大泽乡，遇雨失期，斩尉起事，攻下蕲、铚、酂、苦、柘、谯，入陈，陈胜自立为王，号张楚。北边戍卒散去，匈奴渐复度河南。
snaps.erae: Second Emperor of Qin, year 1, 7th month
snaps.de: The First Emperor died at Shaqiu in the 7th month of 210 BC; Zhao Gao and Li Si forged an order for Fusu to kill himself and set up Huhai as Second Emperor, and Meng Tian was forced to take his own life. In the 7th month of the Second Emperor's first year the conscripts Chen Sheng and Wu Guang, held up by rain at Dazexiang and unable to arrive on time, killed their officers and rose, taking Qi, Zhi, Cuo, Ku, Zhe and Qiao and entering Chen, where Chen Sheng made himself king of Zhang Chu. With the northern garrisons breaking up, the Xiongnu began to cross back into the Ordos.

snaps.d: 张楚遣将四出：吴广围荥阳，周文西入关至戏，武臣北略赵地，周巿略魏地，邓宗徇九江。八月武臣自立为赵王；九月韩广自立为燕王，田儋杀狄令自立为齐王。同月项梁、项羽杀会稽守殷通起兵，刘邦起于沛，称沛公。秦遣少府章邯赦骊山徒击周文。
snaps.de: Zhang Chu sent its generals out in all directions: Wu Guang besieged Xingyang, Zhou Wen went west through the passes as far as Xi, Wu Chen went north to take the Zhao lands, Zhou Fu the Wei lands and Deng Zong Jiujiang. In the 8th month Wu Chen made himself king of Zhao; in the 9th Han Guang made himself king of Yan and Tian Dan killed the magistrate of Di and made himself king of Qi. In the same month Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu killed Yin Tong, Administrator of Kuaiji, and raised troops, and Liu Bang rose at Pei as Lord of Pei. Qin sent the Privy Treasurer Zhang Han with an army of pardoned Lishan labourers against Zhou Wen.

snaps.d: 章邯破周文于曹阳、渑池，吴广为部将田臧所杀，荥阳之围解。十二月章邯攻陈，陈胜败走，至下城父为御者庄贾所杀，张楚瓦解。赵王武臣为部将李良所杀，张耳、陈余立赵歇为赵王；周巿立魏公子咎为魏王，都临济。张楚余部秦嘉立景驹为楚王。
snaps.de: Zhang Han broke Zhou Wen at Caoyang and Mianchi, Wu Guang was killed by his officer Tian Zang and the siege of Xingyang was lifted. In the 12th month Zhang Han attacked Chen; Chen Sheng fled and was killed at Xiachengfu by his charioteer Zhuang Jia, and Zhang Chu collapsed. Wu Chen, king of Zhao, was killed by his general Li Liang, and Zhang Er and Chen Yu set up Zhao Xie as king of Zhao; Zhou Fu set up Prince Jiu of Wei as king of Wei at Linji. Qin Jia, of Zhang Chu's remnant forces, made Jing Ju king of Chu.

snaps.d: 项梁渡江北上，并陈婴、英布、蒲将军之众，击杀秦嘉，景驹走死梁地，刘邦来属。章邯破临济，魏王咎自焚，救魏的齐王田儋战死。六月项梁用范增之计，于盱台立楚怀王之孙心为楚王，仍号怀王；又立韩公子成为韩王，张良为司徒。齐人立田假为王，田荣不服。
snaps.de: Xiang Liang crossed the Yangzi and moved north, absorbing the forces of Chen Ying, Ying Bu and General Pu, killing Qin Jia, while Jing Ju fled and died in Liang; Liu Bang joined him. Zhang Han took Linji, the king of Wei burned himself to death and Tian Dan, king of Qi, who had come to Wei's aid, fell in battle. In the 6th month, on Fan Zeng's advice, Xiang Liang set up Xin, grandson of King Huai of Chu, as king of Chu at Xuyi, still styled King Huai, and made Cheng, a prince of Han (韓), king of Han with Zhang Liang as minister. The men of Qi set up Tian Jia as king, which Tian Rong would not accept.

snaps.d: 项梁连破秦军于东阿、濮阳、定陶，渐有骄色。秦悉起兵益章邯，九月夜袭定陶，项梁战死。楚怀王自盱台徙都彭城，项羽、刘邦东还。章邯以为楚地不足忧，渡河北击赵，破邯郸，徙其民于河内，王离围赵王歇于巨鹿。魏豹复下魏地二十余城，自立为魏王。
snaps.de: Xiang Liang beat the Qin armies at Dong'e, Puyang and Dingtao and grew overconfident. Qin threw every man it had into Zhang Han's army, which fell on Dingtao by night in the 9th month; Xiang Liang was killed. King Huai moved his court from Xuyi to Pengcheng, and Xiang Yu and Liu Bang fell back east. Thinking Chu no longer a threat, Zhang Han crossed the Yellow River to attack Zhao, took Handan and moved its people to Henei, while Wang Li besieged King Xie of Zhao at Julu. Wei Bao won back more than twenty cities of Wei and made himself king.

snaps.d: 怀王遣宋义、项羽北救赵，遣刘邦西略地入关，约「先入定关中者王之」。宋义逗留安阳，项羽斩之，引兵渡河，「皆沉船，破釜甑」，九战绝秦甬道，大破王离军于巨鹿，诸侯军皆作壁上观。战后诸侯将入辕门，莫敢仰视，皆属项羽。章邯退保棘原。
snaps.de: King Huai sent Song Yi and Xiang Yu north to relieve Zhao and Liu Bang west into the passes, promising that whoever first took Guanzhong would be its king. When Song Yi lingered at Anyang, Xiang Yu beheaded him and led the army across the river, 'sinking the boats and smashing the cooking pots'; in nine battles he cut the Qin supply road and routed Wang Li's army at Julu while the allied armies watched from their ramparts. Afterwards the allied generals entered his camp gate, none daring to look up, and all placed themselves under him. Zhang Han fell back to Jiyuan.

snaps.d: 章邯为赵高所疑，屡败于项羽，七月率二十万众降于殷墟，项羽立之为雍王。刘邦自南阳西进，七月降宛，八月破武关。赵高指鹿为马，八月逼杀二世于望夷宫，去帝号，立子婴为秦王。申阳下河南，司马卬定河内。
snaps.te: Zhang Han surrenders · Second Emperor killed
snaps.de: Distrusted by Zhao Gao and repeatedly beaten by Xiang Yu, Zhang Han surrendered with 200,000 men at the ruins of Yin in the 7th month, and Xiang Yu named him king of Yong. Liu Bang advanced west from Nanyang, taking the surrender of Wan in the 7th month and forcing Wu Pass in the 8th. Zhao Gao, who had called a deer a horse, forced the Second Emperor to kill himself at the Wangyi Palace in the 8th month, dropped the imperial title and set up Ziying as king of Qin. Shen Yang took Henan and Sima Ang Henei.

snaps.d: 子婴诛赵高。汉元年十月，刘邦军至霸上，子婴素车白马，系颈以组，封皇帝玺符节，降于轵道旁，秦亡（通鉴系此年，教科书多作前207）。刘邦入咸阳，封府库，还军霸上，与关中父老约法三章。十二月项羽破函谷关，至戏，鸿门宴上刘邦脱身；项羽屠咸阳，杀子婴，焚秦宫室。南海尉赵佗绝道自守，闽越无诸亦据闽中自保。
snaps.de: Ziying had Zhao Gao put to death. In the 10th month of Han year 1, when Liu Bang's army reached Bashang, Ziying came out in a plain white carriage drawn by white horses, a cord round his neck, bearing the sealed imperial seals and tallies, and surrendered beside the Zhi road: Qin had fallen (the Tongjian dates this to this year; many textbooks give 207 BC). Liu Bang entered Xianyang, sealed the treasuries, returned to Bashang and agreed a three-article code with the elders of Guanzhong. In the 12th month Xiang Yu broke through the Hangu Pass to Xi, where Liu Bang slipped away from the Hongmen banquet; Xiang Yu then sacked Xianyang, killed Ziying and burned the Qin palaces. Zhao Tuo, commandant of Nanhai, cut the roads and held the south for himself, and Wuzhu of Minyue too went his own way.

snaps.d: 项羽尊怀王为义帝，自立为西楚霸王，王梁楚九郡，都彭城；分天下为十八国：刘邦为汉王，王巴蜀汉中；三分关中，以章邯、司马欣、董翳为雍、塞、翟王以拒汉；徙魏豹为西魏王、赵歇为代王、韩广为辽东王、田市为胶东王，立张耳、英布、吴芮、共敖、臧荼、田都、田安、申阳、司马卬诸人为王。韩王成随项羽东行，不得就国。四月诸侯各就国，刘邦烧绝栈道入汉中。
snaps.de: Xiang Yu honoured King Huai as Righteous Emperor and made himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu, ruling nine commanderies of Liang and Chu from Pengcheng, and divided the realm into eighteen kingdoms: Liu Bang became king of Han, with Ba, Shu and Hanzhong; Guanzhong was split in three, with Zhang Han, Sima Xin and Dong Yi as kings of Yong, Sai and Di to bottle up Han; Wei Bao was moved to Western Wei, Zhao Xie to Dai, Han Guang to Liaodong and Tian Shi to Jiaodong, while Zhang Er, Ying Bu, Wu Rui, Gong Ao, Zang Tu, Tian Du, Tian An, Shen Yang and Sima Ang were made kings. Han Cheng, king of Han (韓), was kept with Xiang Yu and never reached his kingdom. In the 4th month the lords left for their kingdoms, and Liu Bang burned the plank roads behind him as he entered Hanzhong.

snaps.d: 分封方毕，天下复乱。五月田荣逐田都，六月杀田市，七月又击杀济北王田安，并王三齐。陈余向田荣借兵，谋袭常山王张耳。项羽杀韩王成，以郑昌为韩王。八月刘邦用韩信之计，出故道击雍王章邯，章邯退守废丘，塞王司马欣、翟王董翳降汉。臧荼击杀辽东王韩广，并其地。
snaps.te: The Three Qins retaken · Tian Rong unites Qi
snaps.de: The enfeoffment had barely been made when the realm fell apart again. In the 5th month Tian Rong drove out Tian Du, in the 6th he killed Tian Shi, and in the 7th killed Tian An, king of Jibei, taking all three Qi kingdoms; Chen Yu sought troops from Qi to attack Zhang Er, king of Changshan. Xiang Yu killed Han Cheng and made Zheng Chang king of Han (韓). In the 8th month Liu Bang, on Han Xin's plan, came out by the Old Road against Zhang Han, king of Yong, who fell back to hold Feiqiu, while Sima Xin of Sai and Dong Yi of Di surrendered to Han. Zang Tu killed Han Guang, king of Liaodong, and annexed his land.

snaps.d: 汉王东出：河南王申阳降，韩信（韩襄王孙）破郑昌，立为韩王，殷王司马卬被虏；陈余逐张耳、复立赵歇，赵歇立陈余为代王。项羽北击田荣，田荣败死，齐人立田广。项羽已于十月弑义帝于江中，三月汉王为之发丧，四月率五诸侯兵五十六万人入彭城。项羽以精兵三万自齐回师，大破汉军于彭城、睢水，汉王仅以数十骑脱走，诸侯复附楚，魏豹叛汉。
snaps.de: The king of Han struck east: Shen Yang, king of Henan, surrendered; Han Xin, grandson of King Xiang of Han (韓), beat Zheng Chang and was made king of Han; Sima Ang, king of Yin, was captured. Chen Yu drove out Zhang Er, restored Zhao Xie, who made him king of Dai. Xiang Yu went north against Tian Rong, who was defeated and killed, and the men of Qi set up Tian Guang. Earlier, in the 10th month, Xiang Yu had had the Righteous Emperor murdered on the Yangzi; in the 3rd month the king of Han proclaimed mourning for him, and in the 4th month led 560,000 men of five allied lords into Pengcheng. Xiang Yu came back from Qi with 30,000 picked troops and crushed the Han army at Pengcheng and on the Sui River; the king of Han escaped with a few dozen horsemen, the lords went back over to Chu and Wei Bao turned against Han.

snaps.d: 汉王收散卒屯荥阳，萧何发关中兵补之，与楚相持于京、索之间。六月引水灌废丘，章邯自杀，关中尽为汉有，汉王都栎阳。八月韩信击西魏，陈船临晋，自夏阳以木罂缻渡军，袭安邑，九月虏魏豹，置河东、太原、上党郡；后九月破代兵，擒夏说于阏与。
snaps.te: Han Xin conquers Wei and Dai
snaps.de: The king of Han gathered his scattered men at Xingyang, Xiao He sent reinforcements from Guanzhong, and the two sides faced each other between Jing and Suo. In the 6th month the Han flooded Feiqiu and Zhang Han killed himself, leaving all Guanzhong to Han, whose king ruled from Yueyang. In the 8th month Han Xin attacked Western Wei: he massed boats at Linjin but carried his army across at Xiayang on wooden jars, fell on Anyi and in the 9th month captured Wei Bao, making Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang commanderies; in the intercalary 9th month he broke the Dai army and captured Xia Yue at Yuyu.

snaps.d: 十月韩信、张耳以数万人东下井陉，背水为阵，拔赵帜立汉赤帜，破赵军二十万，斩陈余于泜水，擒赵歇；燕王臧荼闻风降汉。十二月九江王英布归汉，其地为项羽所并。项羽数断汉甬道，五月纪信诈降，汉王出荥阳；荥阳、成皋相继失守，周苛被杀。汉王北渡河，夺韩信军，复与楚相持于巩、洛。
snaps.de: In the 10th month Han Xin and Zhang Er came down the Jingxing pass with a few tens of thousands of men, fought with their backs to a river, pulled down the Zhao flags and raised the red flags of Han, routed a Zhao army of 200,000, beheaded Chen Yu on the Zhi River and captured Zhao Xie; Zang Tu, king of Yan, promptly submitted to Han. In the 12th month Ying Bu, king of Jiujiang, went over to Han and Xiang Yu annexed his land. Xiang Yu repeatedly cut the Han supply road; in the 5th month Ji Xin pretended to surrender so that the king of Han could escape from Xingyang. Xingyang and Chenggao fell one after the other and Zhou Ke was killed. The king of Han crossed to the north bank of the Yellow River, took over Han Xin's army and again held the line against Chu at Gong and Luo.

snaps.d: 郦食其说降齐王田广，韩信用蒯通之计乘虚袭齐，十月破历下，入临淄，田广烹郦食其东走。项羽遣龙且将二十万救齐，十一月韩信夜囊沙壅潍水上流，半渡决之，斩龙且，虏田广，尽定齐地。同月汉王立张耳为赵王。此前十月汉军已大破楚大司马曹咎于汜水，夺回成皋，与项羽对峙于广武。
snaps.de: Li Yiji had talked Tian Guang, king of Qi, into submitting, but Han Xin, on Kuai Tong's advice, struck while Qi was off guard: in the 10th month he broke Lixia and entered Linzi, and Tian Guang boiled Li Yiji alive and fled east. Xiang Yu sent Long Ju with 200,000 men to save Qi; in the 11th month Han Xin dammed the upper Wei River with sandbags by night and released the water when Long Ju's army was half across, beheading Long Ju, capturing Tian Guang and taking all Qi. That month the king of Han made Zhang Er king of Zhao. In the 10th month Han had crushed the Chu Grand Marshal Cao Jiu on the Si River, retaken Chenggao and come face to face with Xiang Yu at Guangwu.

snaps.d: 二月汉王立韩信为齐王；七月立英布为淮南王。彭越往来梁地，绝楚粮道。项羽兵疲食尽，八月与汉约中分天下，割鸿沟以西为汉、以东为楚，九月归还太公、吕后，解而东归；汉王用张良、陈平之计，背约追击。
snaps.de: In the 2nd month the king of Han made Han Xin king of Qi, and in the 7th made Ying Bu king of Huainan. Peng Yue roamed the Liang lands cutting Chu's supply lines. With his men exhausted and his food gone, Xiang Yu agreed in the 8th month to divide the realm with Han at the Honggou Canal, Han taking the west and Chu the east. In the 9th month he sent back Liu Bang's father and wife, broke camp and turned east; the king of Han, on the advice of Zhang Liang and Chen Ping, broke the treaty and went after him.

snaps.d: 汉王追项羽至固陵，韩信、彭越不至，汉军败；汉王许以陈以东傅海与齐王、睢阳以北至穀城与彭越，诸侯乃会。十二月韩信、彭越、英布、刘贾合围项羽于垓下，夜闻四面楚歌，项羽溃围南走，至乌江自刎。楚地皆降，惟鲁坚守，持项羽首示之乃降。汉又遣卢绾、刘贾击临江王共尉。
snaps.de: The king of Han caught up with Xiang Yu at Guling but Han Xin and Peng Yue failed to come, and the Han army was beaten; only when he promised the king of Qi the land east of Chen to the sea, and Peng Yue the land from Suiyang north to Gucheng, did the lords join him. In the 12th month Han Xin, Peng Yue, Ying Bu and Liu Jia surrounded Xiang Yu at Gaixia; hearing the songs of Chu on every side at night, he broke out to the south and cut his own throat at Wujiang. The Chu lands all submitted; only Lu held out until shown Xiang Yu's head. Lu Wan and Liu Jia were sent against Gong Wei, king of Linjiang.

snaps.d: 正月徙齐王韩信为楚王，都下邳；立彭越为梁王，都定陶。二月甲午汉王即皇帝位于汜水之阳，是为汉高祖。异姓七王：楚王韩信、梁王彭越、淮南王英布、长沙王吴芮、韩王信、赵王张耳、燕王臧荼；关中、巴蜀与关东诸郡为汉直辖。五月罢兵归家，用娄敬之议定都关中（先居栎阳）。
snaps.de: In the 1st month Han Xin was moved from Qi to be king of Chu at Xiapi, and Peng Yue was made king of Liang at Dingtao. On the jiawu day of the 2nd month the king of Han took the imperial throne north of the Si River: he was Emperor Gaozu of Han. Seven kings of other surnames held their own realms — Han Xin of Chu, Peng Yue of Liang, Ying Bu of Huainan, Wu Rui of Changsha, Han Xin of Han (韓), Zhang Er of Zhao and Zang Tu of Yan — while Guanzhong, Ba–Shu and the commanderies east of the passes were ruled directly. In the 5th month the troops were sent home, and on Lou Jing's advice the capital was fixed in Guanzhong (first at Yueyang).

snaps.d: 冒顿东灭东胡、西走月氏，南并楼烦、白羊河南王，北服浑庾、屈射、丁零、鬲昆、薪犁，尽收蒙恬所夺地。高祖疑忌功臣：燕王臧荼反被诛，以卢绾为燕王；楚王韩信被擒于陈，楚分为荆、楚；立长子刘肥为齐王。韩王信徙太原、都马邑，降匈奴。七年高祖亲征，被围于白登七日，用陈平计得脱，此后与匈奴和亲。
snaps.de: Modu destroyed the Donghu to the east, drove off the Yuezhi to the west, absorbed the Loufan and Baiyang kings of the Ordos to the south and subdued the Hunyu, Qushe, Dingling, Gekun and Xinli to the north, taking back all the land Meng Tian had seized. Gaozu grew wary of his generals: Zang Tu, king of Yan, rebelled and was killed, Lu Wan replacing him; Han Xin, king of Chu, was seized at Chen and Chu split into Jing and Chu; Gaozu's eldest son Liu Fei became king of Qi. Han Xin, king of Han (韓), was moved to Taiyuan with his capital at Mayi and went over to the Xiongnu. In year 7 Gaozu led an army himself and was surrounded at Baideng for seven days, escaping by a stratagem of Chen Ping; thereafter Han made peace with the Xiongnu through marriage alliances (heqin).

snaps.d: 异姓诸王相继覆灭：赵王张敖废，梁王彭越、淮南王英布被诛，燕王卢绾亡入匈奴，惟长沙王吴氏得存。刘氏子弟分王关东：齐、楚、吴、淮南、梁、淮阳、赵、代、燕，「非刘氏而王者，天下共击之」。王国大者跨州兼郡，汉廷直辖者仅十五郡。高祖遣陆贾立赵佗为南越王。四月高祖崩。
snaps.te: Death of Gaozu · kings of the Liu clan
snaps.de: The kings of other surnames fell one after another: Zhang Ao of Zhao was deposed, Peng Yue of Liang and Ying Bu of Huainan were executed and Lu Wan of Yan fled to the Xiongnu; only the Wu family of Changsha survived. Sons and brothers of the Liu clan were made kings east of the passes — Qi, Chu, Wu, Huainan, Liang, Huaiyang, Zhao, Dai and Yan — under the oath that 'if anyone not of the Liu clan becomes king, let the realm unite to strike him'. The great kingdoms spanned many commanderies, while the court ruled only fifteen directly. Gaozu sent Lu Jia to recognise Zhao Tuo as king of Nanyue, and died in the 4th month.

snaps.d: 吕后临朝，封诸吕为王：吕禄为赵王，吕产为梁王，吕通为燕王，又割齐之济南为吕国、琅邪为琅邪国。前194 年燕人卫满逐朝鲜王准，建卫氏朝鲜；南越赵佗与汉绝，自称南越武帝，发兵攻长沙，又并瓯雒。七月吕后崩，周勃、陈平诛诸吕，后九月迎代王刘恒即位，是为文帝。
snaps.te: The Lü clan purged · Emperor Wen
snaps.de: Empress Lü ruled from the court and made kings of her kinsmen — Lü Lu in Zhao, Lü Chan in Liang, Lü Tong in Yan — and carved the kingdoms of Lü (from Jinan) and Langya out of Qi. In 194 BC Wiman of Yan had driven out King Jun of Joseon and founded Wiman Joseon; Zhao Tuo of Nanyue broke with Han, styled himself Emperor Wu of Nanyue, attacked Changsha and annexed Âu Lạc. Empress Lü died in the 7th month; Zhou Bo and Chen Ping wiped out the Lü clan and in the intercalary 9th month brought Liu Heng, king of Dai, to the throne as Emperor Wen.

snaps.d: 贾谊上《治安策》，主张「众建诸侯而少其力」。文帝十六年分齐为齐、济北、济南、菑川、胶西、胶东六国（另有城阳），分淮南为淮南、衡山、庐江三国，皆以故王子弟为王。前176 年冒顿单于击破月氏，老上单于又杀月氏王，月氏大部西迁伊犁；楼兰、乌孙、呼揭及其旁二十六国皆役属匈奴。
snaps.te: Qi split into six · Huainan into three
snaps.de: Jia Yi argued in his Memorial on Order and Security for 'setting up many lords to lessen their strength'. In Emperor Wen's 16th year Qi was divided into the six kingdoms of Qi, Jibei, Jinan, Zichuan, Jiaoxi and Jiaodong (besides Chengyang), and Huainan into Huainan, Hengshan and Lujiang, all given to sons of the former kings. The chanyu Modu had crushed the Yuezhi in 176 BC, and after the chanyu Laoshang killed their king most of them moved west to the Ili valley; Loulan, Wusun, Hujie and twenty-six neighbouring states all became subject to the Xiongnu.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 晁错上《削藩策》，削楚之东海、赵之常山、胶西六县。正月吴王刘濞联合楚、赵、胶西、胶东、菑川、济南起兵，以「诛晁错，清君侧」为名。景帝斩晁错，遣周亚夫坚壁昌邑，以轻骑断吴楚粮道，梁王坚守睢阳；三月吴楚溃，刘濞走东越被杀，七国皆平。此后王国不得自治民补吏，汉廷收其支郡，王国渐同于郡。
snaps.de: Chao Cuo memorialised for cutting down the kingdoms, and Donghai was taken from Chu, Changshan from Zhao and six counties from Jiaoxi. In the 1st month Liu Bi, king of Wu, rose with Chu, Zhao, Jiaoxi, Jiaodong, Zichuan and Jinan, claiming to 'execute Chao Cuo and purge the emperor's side'. Emperor Jing had Chao Cuo beheaded and sent Zhou Yafu, who dug in at Changyi and cut the Wu–Chu supply lines with light cavalry while the king of Liang held Suiyang; in the 3rd month Wu and Chu collapsed, Liu Bi fled to Dongyue and was killed, and all seven were crushed. Thereafter kings could no longer govern their people or appoint officials, the court took back their outlying commanderies and the kingdoms became little different from commanderies.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 武帝即位，前139 年前后遣张骞以郎应募，出陇西往使大月氏，欲共击匈奴，途中为匈奴所留十余年。闽越发兵围东瓯，东瓯告急，严助发会稽兵浮海往救，闽越引去；东瓯王请举国内徙，四万余人徙处江淮之间，其地空。
snaps.te: Dong'ou moves inland · Zhang Qian goes west
snaps.de: Emperor Wu came to the throne, and around 139 BC Zhang Qian, a palace attendant who had volunteered, set out from Longxi as envoy to the Great Yuezhi to seek an alliance against the Xiongnu; he was held by the Xiongnu on the way for more than ten years. Minyue besieged Dong'ou; when Dong'ou appealed for help Yan Zhu brought the Kuaiji troops by sea and Minyue withdrew. The king of Dong'ou asked to move his whole kingdom, and over forty thousand people were resettled between the Yangzi and the Huai, leaving the land empty.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 前133 年马邑之谋不成，汉匈和亲断绝。前129 年四将军各将万骑分道出塞，卫青初次领兵，出上谷直捣匈奴祭天的龙城，斩首虏七百，其余三路或败或无功；前128 年卫青再出雁门，斩首虏数千。元朔二年卫青、李息出云中，沿河西至高阙，迂回南下至陇西，击走白羊、楼烦王，捕首虏数千、牛羊百余万，全甲兵而还，尽收河南地，卫青封长平侯；置朔方、五原郡，募民十万口徙朔方，复缮蒙恬故塞。同年用主父偃之策行推恩令，诸侯王得分邑封子弟为列侯，王国由是愈小；齐国以齐王刘次昌自杀国除。前128 年濊君南闾降，置苍海郡。
snaps.de: After the failed ambush at Mayi in 133 BC the peace between Han and the Xiongnu broke down. In 129 BC four generals each led ten thousand horsemen out by separate roads; Wei Qing, in his first command, struck from Shanggu at Longcheng, where the Xiongnu sacrificed to Heaven, and took seven hundred heads and prisoners, while the other three columns were beaten or came back empty-handed. In 128 BC he went out again from Yanmen and took several thousand. In Yuanshuo 2 Wei Qing and Li Xi set out from Yunzhong, followed the river west to Gaoque and swung south to Longxi, driving off the Baiyang and Loufan kings; they took several thousand heads and prisoners and more than a million cattle and sheep, came home with the army intact and recovered the whole of the Ordos, and Wei Qing was made Marquis of Changping. Shuofang and Wuyuan commanderies were set up, a hundred thousand settlers were recruited for Shuofang, and Meng Tian's old frontier defences were repaired. The same year, on Zhufu Yan's advice, the Edict of Grace allowed kings to divide their lands among younger sons as marquisates, so the kingdoms grew ever smaller; Qi was abolished when its king, Liu Cichang, killed himself. In 128 BC the Ye chief Namnyeo had submitted and Canghai Commandery had been set up.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 前124 年春，卫青将三万骑出朔方高阙，诸将合十余万分道并出，北行六七百里，夜围右贤王庭。右贤王以为汉兵不能至，饮醉，惊起，独与爱妾一人、壮骑数百溃围北去；汉得裨王十余人、众男女万五千余人、畜数千百万。武帝遣使者持大将军印，就军中拜卫青为大将军，诸将皆属焉，三子在襁褓中皆封侯。前123 年二月、四月，卫青两出定襄，斩首虏万余；年十八的剽姚校尉霍去病以轻勇骑八百弃大军数百里赴利，斩首虏二千余，斩单于大父行籍若侯产，生擒季父罗姑比，封冠军侯。前将军赵信兵败降匈奴，教单于「益北绝幕」以诱疲汉兵，单于庭由此北移。前126 年张骞自西域归汉。
snaps.de: In the spring of 124 BC Wei Qing led 30,000 horsemen out from Gaoque in Shuofang, while the other generals, bringing the total to more than 100,000 men, advanced by separate roads. Six or seven hundred li to the north he surrounded the camp of the Wise King of the Right by night. The king, sure that no Han army could reach him, was drunk; he woke and broke out northward with one favourite concubine and a few hundred picked riders, and Han took more than ten lesser kings, over 15,000 men and women and livestock running into the millions. The emperor sent an envoy with the seal of Grand General to appoint Wei Qing in the field, with all the generals under him, and made marquises of his three sons, still in swaddling clothes. In the 2nd and 4th months of 123 BC Wei Qing twice marched out of Dingxiang and took over ten thousand heads and prisoners. Huo Qubing, the eighteen-year-old Piaoyao Colonel, left the main army hundreds of li behind with eight hundred light horse, took over two thousand heads and prisoners, killed the chanyu's grand-uncle Chan, Marquis of Jiruo, captured his uncle Luogubi alive, and was made Marquis of Guanjun. The General of the Van, Zhao Xin, was defeated and went over to the Xiongnu; he told the chanyu to withdraw 'farther north across the desert' to lure the Han armies on and wear them out, and the chanyu's court moved north. Zhang Qian had come back from the Western Regions in 126 BC.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 元狩二年春，骠骑将军霍去病将万骑出陇西，六日转战五王国，过焉支山千余里，鏖战皋兰山下，杀折兰王、卢胡王，执浑邪王子，收休屠王祭天金人；夏，与公孙敖分道出北地，公孙敖失道，霍去病独逾居延，经小月氏至祁连山，斩首虏三万余；李广、张骞同时出右北平牵制左贤王。秋，单于怒浑邪王屡败，欲诛之，浑邪王杀休屠王，率四万余众降汉，霍去病渡河受降，汉分处其众于五属国。匈奴歌曰：「亡我祁连山，使我六畜不蕃息；失我焉支山，使我妇女无颜色。」河西走廊尽为汉有，自金城河西并南山至盐泽空无匈奴；此后陆续在河西置郡（建郡年份诸说不一，见各郡说明）。前122 年淮南王刘安、衡山王刘赐谋反，二国除。
snaps.de: In the spring of Yuanshou 2 Huo Qubing, General of Swift Cavalry, led ten thousand horsemen out of Longxi, fought his way through five Xiongnu kingdoms in six days and pressed more than a thousand li past Mount Yanzhi; in a bloody close-quarters fight below Mount Gaolan he killed the Zhelan and Luhu kings, captured the Hunye king's son and took the golden statue the Xiutu king used to worship Heaven. In summer he and Gongsun Ao set out from Beidi by separate roads; Gongsun Ao lost his way, and Huo Qubing went on alone past Juyan and through the Lesser Yuezhi lands to the Qilian Mountains, taking more than 30,000 heads and prisoners, while Li Guang and Zhang Qian went out from Youbeiping to pin down the Wise King of the Left. In autumn the chanyu, furious at the Hunye king's repeated defeats, meant to have him killed; the Hunye king killed the Xiutu king and surrendered with over 40,000 people, Huo Qubing crossed the Yellow River to receive them, and they were settled in five dependent states. The Xiongnu sang: 'We have lost our Qilian Mountains, and our herds no longer thrive; we have lost our Mount Yanzhi, and our women have lost their colour.' The whole Hexi Corridor became Han, and from Jincheng west along the Southern Mountains to the Salt Marsh there were no more Xiongnu; commanderies were set up in Hexi over the following years (the dates are disputed; see each commandery). Liu An of Huainan and Liu Ci of Hengshan were found plotting rebellion in 122 BC and both kingdoms were abolished.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 元狩四年春，汉发骑十万，私马从者共十四万匹，步兵转运者数十万，令卫青、霍去病各将五万骑分道绝幕。卫青出定襄千余里，遇伊稚斜单于陈兵以待，以武刚车环为营，纵五千骑往击；日暮大风扬沙，两军不相见，汉益纵左右翼绕单于，单于与壮骑数百溃围西北遁，汉军追至窴颜山赵信城，取其积粟食军，烧余粟而还；前将军李广失道后期，自刭。霍去病出代二千余里，历涉离侯，济弓闾，破左贤王，斩首虏七万余，封狼居胥山，禅于姑衍，登临翰海而还。「是后匈奴远遁，而幕南无王庭」；汉亦马死十余万匹，此后多年不复大举出塞。武帝置大司马，卫青、霍去病并为大司马。汉徙乌桓于五郡塞外，以护乌桓校尉监之。
snaps.de: In the spring of Yuanshou 4 Han raised 100,000 cavalry, with 140,000 horses in all counting those the men brought privately, and hundreds of thousands of foot soldiers to carry supplies, and sent Wei Qing and Huo Qubing across the desert by separate roads with 50,000 horse each. More than a thousand li out of Dingxiang, Wei Qing found the chanyu Yizhixie drawn up waiting for him. He circled his armoured wagons into a laager and loosed five thousand horse at the enemy; at dusk a gale threw up the sand so that neither side could see the other, Han sent its wings round the chanyu, and the chanyu broke out to the north-west with a few hundred picked riders. The Han army pursued as far as Zhao Xin's fort at Mount Tianyan, fed itself on the grain stored there, burned the rest and turned back; the General of the Van, Li Guang, lost his way, arrived too late and cut his own throat. Huo Qubing marched more than two thousand li from Dai, passed Lihou, crossed the Gonglü, crushed the Wise King of the Left and took over 70,000 heads and prisoners; he sacrificed to Heaven on Mount Langjuxu and to Earth on Mount Guyan, climbed to look out over the Hanhai, and turned back. 'After this the Xiongnu fled far away, and there was no royal court south of the desert'; but Han had lost more than a hundred thousand horses and did not campaign on such a scale again for years. The emperor created the post of Grand Marshal and gave it to both Wei Qing and Huo Qubing. Han moved the Wuhuan beyond the frontier of five commanderies under a Protector of the Wuhuan.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 南越相吕嘉杀王及汉使，元鼎五年路博德、杨仆五路进兵，六年冬破番禺，以其地置南海、苍梧、郁林、合浦、交趾、九真、日南、珠崖、儋耳九郡。回师平且兰，夜郎王入朝，以其地为牂柯郡，并置越嶲、沈黎、汶山、武都郡。同年李息击西羌，置护羌校尉；张骞二使西域已于前115 年归汉。前117 年霍去病卒，年二十四，武帝为起冢茂陵旁，象祁连山。
snaps.de: Lü Jia, chancellor of Nanyue, killed his king and the Han envoys; in Yuanding 5 Lu Bode and Yang Pu advanced by five routes and in the winter of year 6 took Panyu, making the land into the nine commanderies of Nanhai, Cangwu, Yulin, Hepu, Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen, Rinan, Zhuya and Dan'er. On the way back the army destroyed Qielan; the king of Yelang came to court and his land became Zangke Commandery, while Yuexi, Shenli, Wenshan and Wudu commanderies were also set up. That year Li Xi attacked the Western Qiang and a Protector of the Qiang was appointed; Zhang Qian had returned from his second mission to the west in 115 BC. Huo Qubing had died in 117 BC, aged twenty-four; the emperor built him a tomb in the shape of the Qilian Mountains beside his own mausoleum at Maoling.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 前110 年汉灭闽越、东越，徙其民于江淮；前109 年滇王降，置益州郡。卫氏朝鲜右渠王阻真番诸国朝汉，杀辽东都尉涉何；楼船将军杨仆浮渤海、左将军荀彘出辽东夹击，元封三年夏王险城降，以其地置乐浪、临屯、真番、玄菟四郡。赵破奴虏楼兰王、破车师，汉自酒泉列亭障至玉门。至此武帝开边大体告成，郡国并行之局见于全图。
snaps.de: In 110 BC Han destroyed Minyue and Dongyue and moved their peoples to the Yangzi–Huai region; in 109 BC the king of Dian surrendered and Yizhou Commandery was set up. Ugeo, king of Wiman Joseon, blocked Zhenfan and other states from coming to the Han court and killed the Liaodong commandant She He; Yang Pu, General of the Towered Ships, crossed the Bohai while General of the Left Xun Zhi came out of Liaodong, and in the summer of Yuanfeng 3 Wangxian surrendered, the land becoming the four commanderies of Lelang, Lintun, Zhenfan and Xuantu. Zhao Ponu captured the king of Loulan and broke Jushi, and Han built a line of watchtowers from Jiuquan to the Jade Gate. Emperor Wu's expansion was now largely complete, and the whole map shows commanderies and kingdoms side by side.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 前104 年改用太初历，以正月为岁首。贰师将军李广利求汗血马，首伐大宛不利；太初三年再发兵六万，围贵山城四十余日，大宛贵人杀王毋寡，献马三千余匹，汉立亲汉的昧蔡为王。「西域震惧」，汉自敦煌西至盐泽往往起亭，轮台、渠犁屯田数百人，置使者校尉。光禄勋徐自为筑五原塞外列城（光禄塞），路博德筑居延泽上。前106 年大将军卫青卒，起冢茂陵旁，象庐山（匈奴境内的山）。
snaps.de: In 104 BC the Taichu calendar was adopted, making the 1st month the start of the year. Li Guangli, the Ershi General, went for Dayuan's 'blood-sweating' horses; his first campaign failed, but in Taichu 3 he set out again with 60,000 men and besieged Guishan for over forty days, until the Dayuan nobles killed their king Wugua, handed over more than three thousand horses, and Han installed the pro-Han Meicai as king. 'The Western Regions shook with fear': Han built watch posts all the way west from Dunhuang to the Salt Marsh, settled several hundred farming soldiers at Luntai and Quli under an envoy-commandant, while the Superintendent of the Palace Xu Ziwei built the chain of forts beyond Wuyuan (the Guanglu frontier) and Lu Bode fortified Lake Juyan. Wei Qing, the Grand General, had died in 106 BC; his tomb beside Maoling was built in the shape of Mount Lu, a mountain in the Xiongnu lands.

labe.69: Oasis states (under the Xiongnu Commandant of Slaves)

snaps.d: 前100 年中郎将苏武出使匈奴被扣，单于徙之北海牧羊，留匈奴十九年，前81 年始归。前87 年武帝崩，此前下轮台诏罢远戍，昭帝时盐铁会议论政、霍光辅政。前71 年汉发五将军十五万骑与乌孙夹击匈奴，匈奴自此衰耗。神爵二年匈奴日逐王先贤掸率众降汉，郑吉迎之，汉以郑吉并护车师以西北道，号西域都护，治乌垒城，统领西域三十六国，「汉之号令班西域矣」。前61 年赵充国屯田湟中，平西羌，置金城属国。
snaps.te: Protectorate of the Western Regions founded
snaps.de: In 100 BC Su Wu, a General of the Household on a mission to the Xiongnu, was detained there, and the chanyu banished him to herd sheep by the North Sea; he was held for nineteen years and came home only in 81 BC. Emperor Wu died in 87 BC, having earlier issued the Luntai edict abandoning distant garrisons; under Emperor Zhao the Salt and Iron debate was held and Huo Guang ruled as regent. In 71 BC Han sent five generals with 150,000 horsemen to attack the Xiongnu together with Wusun, and the Xiongnu declined from then on. In Shenjue 2 the Xiongnu Rizhu king Xianxianshan came over to Han with his people; Zheng Ji went to receive him, and was given charge of the northern route west of Jushi as well, with the title Protector-General of the Western Regions, based at Wulei and overseeing the thirty-six states: 'the commands of Han were proclaimed throughout the Western Regions'. In 61 BC Zhao Chongguo set up farming garrisons on the Huang River, subdued the Western Qiang and created the Jincheng Dependent State.

labe.69: Protectorate of the Western Regions (oasis states)

snaps.d: 前57 年匈奴五单于争立，后并为呼韩邪、郅支两部。呼韩邪为郅支所败，南下近塞，甘露三年正月亲朝宣帝于甘泉宫，称臣，位在诸侯王上，汉遣兵护送其出居光禄塞下，转边谷米以济之。郅支据单于庭，旋西击乌揭、坚昆、丁零，徙居坚昆。前53 年乌孙分大小昆弥。
snaps.de: In 57 BC five chanyus contended for the Xiongnu throne, ending in two camps under Huhanye and Zhizhi. Defeated by Zhizhi, Huhanye moved south close to the frontier, and in the 1st month of Ganlu 3 came in person to Emperor Xuan at the Ganquan Palace, declaring himself a vassal and taking precedence above the kings of the realm; Han troops escorted him out to live below the Guanglu frontier and grain was sent from the border commanderies to feed his people. Zhizhi held the chanyu's court, then struck west against the Wujie, Jiankun and Dingling and moved to the Jiankun lands. In 53 BC Wusun was divided between a greater and a lesser kunmi.

labe.69: Protectorate of the Western Regions (oasis states)

snaps.d: 呼韩邪于前43 年北归单于庭，匈奴复归一统而称臣于汉。郅支杀汉使谷吉，西投康居，役使康居、筑城于都赖水上，威胁乌孙、大宛。建昭三年西域副校尉陈汤矫制，与都护甘延寿发西域十五国兵及屯田吏士四万余人，分南北两道，南道越葱岭、经大宛，北道经乌孙，围郅支城，斩郅支单于，传首京师，上书曰「明犯强汉者，虽远必诛」。
snaps.de: Huhanye returned north to the chanyu's court in 43 BC, and the Xiongnu, reunited, remained a Han vassal. Zhizhi had killed the Han envoy Gu Ji and gone west to Kangju, which he dominated, building a fortress on the Talas from which he threatened Wusun and Dayuan. In Jianzhao 3 the Deputy Colonel of the Western Regions Chen Tang, forging an imperial order, joined the Protector-General Gan Yanshou in raising more than 40,000 men from fifteen states of the Western Regions and the farming garrisons; marching by two routes, the southern over the Pamirs through Dayuan and the northern through Wusun, they besieged Zhizhi's fortress and beheaded the chanyu, sending his head to the capital with the memorial: 'whoever offends mighty Han, however far away, shall be put to death'.

labe.69: Protectorate of the Western Regions (oasis states)

snaps.d: 前33 年王昭君出塞，嫁呼韩邪单于，汉匈和好六十余年。元始二年为《汉书·地理志》所据的断代：郡国一百零三，县邑一千三百一十四，道三十二，侯国二百四十一，户一千二百二十三万，口五千九百五十九万，为西汉极盛。是时平帝年幼，大司马王莽秉政，号安汉公。西域都护领五十国。
snaps.te: The commanderies and kingdoms of Yuanshi
snaps.de: In 33 BC Wang Zhaojun went out beyond the frontier to marry the chanyu Huhanye, and Han and the Xiongnu were at peace for over sixty years. Yuanshi 2 is the benchmark year of the Han shu Treatise on Geography: 103 commanderies and kingdoms, 1,314 counties, 32 dao and 241 marquisates, 12.23 million households and 59.59 million people — the height of the Western Han. Emperor Ping was a child and Wang Mang, Grand Marshal, ruled as Duke Who Secures the Han. The Protector-General oversaw fifty states.

labe.69: Protectorate of the Western Regions (oasis states)

snaps.d: 初始元年十二月王莽受汉禅，建国号新，改元始建国，以十二月为正月。行王田、私属，五均六筦，改币制；诸侯王降为公，次年皆废；大改郡县名称与长吏官名。又改匈奴单于玺为「新匈奴单于章」，贬句丽王为侯，西域诸国王为侯，四夷离心：匈奴寇边，13 年焉耆杀西域都护但钦。
snaps.de: In the 12th month of Chushi 1 Wang Mang accepted the abdication of Han, naming his dynasty Xin and his era Shijianguo and making the 12th month the 1st. He nationalised land and banned the sale of slaves, set up price controls and state monopolies and changed the coinage; kings were reduced to dukes and abolished the following year, and the names of commanderies, counties and their officials were overhauled. He replaced the Xiongnu chanyu's seal with one reading 'Seal of the Xin Xiongnu chanyu' and demoted the king of Goguryeo and the kings of the Western Regions to marquises, alienating every neighbour: the Xiongnu raided the frontier, and in AD 13 Karasahr killed the Protector-General Dan Qin.

labe.69: Protectorate of the Western Regions (oasis states)

snaps.d: 连年旱蝗，河决魏郡（11 年）后黄河改道东流、河南北久成泽国，饥民四起。17 年王匡、王凤聚众于绿林山；18 年琅邪樊崇起于莒，转战青、徐，以朱涂眉为号，称赤眉。王莽遣廉丹、太师王匡东击，不能制。16 年五威将王骏、西域都护李崇出击焉耆，王骏中伏被杀，李崇收余众退保龟兹，此后与中原隔绝，莽死而没，西域遂绝，是为《后汉书》所说「三绝三通」的第一绝。
snaps.de: Year after year of drought and locusts, together with the Yellow River's breach at Wei Commandery in AD 11 — after which the river changed course to the east and the lands north and south of it lay long under water — drove the starving to revolt. In 17 Wang Kuang and Wang Feng gathered followers at Mount Lülin; in 18 Fan Chong of Langya rose at Ju and fought through Qing and Xu, his men painting their eyebrows red: the Red Eyebrows. The armies Wang Mang sent east under Lian Dan and the Grand Preceptor Wang Kuang could not contain them. In 16 Wang Mang's general Wang Jun and the Protector-General Li Chong attacked Karasahr; Wang Jun was killed in an ambush, and Li Chong withdrew with the survivors to Kucha, where he was cut off from China and died after Wang Mang's fall. The Western Regions were lost: the first of the 'three breaks and three reopenings' of the Hou Han shu.

snaps.d: 二月绿林诸将立刘玄为帝，年号更始。王莽遣王寻、王邑号称百万围昆阳，六月刘秀以三千敢死士冲其中坚，会大雷风，新军溃。邓晔、于匡开武关，九月一日（戊申）汉兵攻入长安，三日（庚戌）王莽死于渐台。更始都洛阳，遣刘秀徇河北；隗嚣据陇右，公孙述据蜀，各自拥兵。
snaps.de: In the 2nd month the Lülin leaders set up Liu Xuan as emperor with the era name Gengshi. Wang Mang sent Wang Xun and Wang Yi with an army said to number a million to besiege Kunyang; in the 6th month Liu Xiu charged their centre with three thousand picked men, a great storm broke, and the Xin army fell apart. Deng Ye and Yu Kuang opened the Wu Pass, Han troops broke into Chang'an on the first day of the 9th month, and on the third Wang Mang was killed at the Jian Terrace. The Gengshi Emperor made Luoyang his capital and sent Liu Xiu to win over Hebei; Wei Xiao held Longyou and Gongsun Shu held Shu, each with his own army.

snaps.d: 刘秀平王郎、收铜马，据有河北，六月即皇帝位于鄗南千秋亭，十月入洛阳，定都，是为东汉。赤眉立刘盆子为帝，九月入长安，更始出降，旋被杀。公孙述称帝于成都，国号成家；梁王刘永称帝于睢阳，张步据齐，董宪据东海，隗嚣据陇右，窦融保河西，秦丰、李宪等各据一方，天下分裂。
snaps.te: Guangwu enthroned · the Red Eyebrows in Chang'an
snaps.de: Liu Xiu crushed Wang Lang and absorbed the Tongma rebels, taking Hebei; in the 6th month he took the throne at the Qianqiu Pavilion south of Hao, and in the 10th entered Luoyang and made it his capital: the Eastern Han had begun. The Red Eyebrows set up Liu Penzi as emperor and entered Chang'an in the 9th month; the Gengshi Emperor surrendered and was soon killed. Gongsun Shu proclaimed himself emperor of Chengjia at Chengdu; Liu Yong, king of Liang, did the same at Suiyang; Zhang Bu held Qi, Dong Xian Donghai, Wei Xiao Longyou and Dou Rong Hexi, while Qin Feng, Li Xian and others held their own corners: the realm was in pieces.

snaps.d: 赤眉在关中掠食殆尽，东归。建武三年正月冯异破之于崤底，光武亲率大军截于宜阳，樊崇、刘盆子君臣面缚请降，关中渐定。刘永为部将所杀，其子刘纡继立；渔阳太守彭宠反，自立为燕王。
snaps.de: Having stripped Guanzhong of food, the Red Eyebrows turned east. In the 1st month of Jianwu 3 Feng Yi beat them at Xiaodi, and the emperor himself blocked their way at Yiyang, where Fan Chong and Liu Penzi surrendered with their hands bound; Guanzhong was gradually pacified. Liu Yong was killed by one of his generals and his son Liu Yu took his place; Peng Chong, Administrator of Yuyang, rebelled and made himself king of Yan.

snaps.d: 建武五年耿弇破张步于临淄，刘纡、彭宠、秦丰相继覆灭；六年董宪、李宪败死，关东悉平。窦融遣使奉书，河西归附。隗嚣遣子入侍后又反，称臣于公孙述；卢芳在匈奴支持下据五原、朔方、云中、定襄、雁门五郡，称帝于九原。光武罢郡国都尉，省并四百余县。
snaps.de: In Jianwu 5 Geng Yan beat Zhang Bu at Linzi, and Liu Yu, Peng Chong and Qin Feng were destroyed one after another; in year 6 Dong Xian and Li Xian fell, and the whole east was pacified. Dou Rong sent envoys with letters of submission, bringing Hexi over. Wei Xiao, having sent his son to court, then turned against Han and declared himself Gongsun Shu's vassal; Lu Fang, backed by the Xiongnu, held the five commanderies of Wuyuan, Shuofang, Yunzhong, Dingxiang and Yanmen and proclaimed himself emperor at Jiuyuan. Emperor Guangwu abolished the commanderies' military commandants and merged away more than four hundred counties.

snaps.d: 建武八年光武亲征隗嚣，窦融率河西兵会于高平，隗嚣走西城；九年隗嚣病饿而死，十年来歙、耿弇等攻落门，隗纯降，陇右平。
snaps.de: In Jianwu 8 the emperor took the field against Wei Xiao in person, Dou Rong joining him at Gaoping with the Hexi army, and Wei Xiao fled to Xicheng; in year 9 he died of illness and hunger, and in year 10 Lai Xi, Geng Yan and others took Luomen, Wei Chun surrendered and Longyou was pacified.

snaps.d: 建武十一年岑彭破荆门、虎牙，溯江入蜀，为刺客所杀；吴汉继之，十二年十一月攻成都，公孙述中创夜死，延岑以城降，成家亡。天下复归一统，惟卢芳仍据北边五郡。窦融随即奉诏入朝，河西诸郡直属东汉。
snaps.de: In Jianwu 11 Cen Peng broke the Jingmen–Huya barrier and advanced up the Yangzi into Shu, where he was killed by an assassin; Wu Han took over, and in the 11th month of year 12 attacked Chengdu; Gongsun Shu was wounded and died that night, Yan Cen surrendered the city and Chengjia was finished. The realm was united again, except that Lu Fang still held the five northern commanderies. Dou Rong was then summoned to court, and the Hexi commanderies passed to the Eastern Han.

snaps.d: 卢芳 40 年降汉，旋复入匈奴；北边屡遭匈奴、乌桓寇掠，39 年徙雁门、代、上谷吏民于居庸关以东。40 年交趾征侧、征贰姊妹起兵，九真、日南、合浦响应，取六十五城；伏波将军马援 42 年南征，43 年斩征侧、征贰，立铜柱为汉界。西域诸国不堪匈奴敛税，建武中皆遣使求内属、愿请都护，光武以天下初定，不许；莎车王贤乘势称雄西域。
snaps.de: Lu Fang surrendered to Han in AD 40 but soon went back to the Xiongnu; the northern frontier suffered repeated Xiongnu and Wuhuan raids, and in 39 the officials and people of Yanmen, Dai and Shanggu were moved east of the Juyong Pass. In 40 the sisters Trưng Trắc and Trưng Nhị rose in Jiaozhi, joined by Jiuzhen, Rinan and Hepu, taking sixty-five towns; Ma Yuan, General Who Calms the Waves, marched south in 42 and in 43 beheaded both sisters, setting up bronze pillars to mark the Han frontier. Unable to bear the Xiongnu's exactions, the states of the Western Regions all sent envoys in the Jianwu era asking to become Han subjects and to be given a Protector-General, but Guangwu, with the empire barely settled, refused; King Xian of Yarkand took the chance to dominate the Western Regions.

snaps.d: 匈奴连年旱蝗，人畜死耗大半，单于继立之争又起。建武二十四年，统领南边八部的日逐王比自立为呼韩邪单于，款五原塞称臣，是为南匈奴；蒲奴单于据漠北，是为北匈奴。50 年南单于入居西河美稷，置使匈奴中郎将护之。49 年乌桓内附，居缘边诸郡。
snaps.te: The Xiongnu split north and south
snaps.de: Years of drought and locusts killed more than half the Xiongnu's people and herds, and the succession was disputed again. In Jianwu 24 Bi, the Rizhu king who led the eight southern tribes, made himself chanyu as Huhanye and came to the Wuyuan frontier to declare himself a vassal: these were the Southern Xiongnu, while the chanyu Punu held the north of the Gobi as the Northern Xiongnu. In 50 the southern chanyu settled at Meiji in Xihe under a General of the Household Sent to the Xiongnu. The Wuhuan submitted in 49 and settled along the frontier commanderies.

snaps.d: 69 年哀牢王柳貌内属，置永昌郡，汉地西达伊洛瓦底江。永平十六年窦固、耿忠出酒泉，击北匈奴呼衍王于天山，追至蒲类海，取伊吾卢地，置宜禾都尉屯田；窦固遣假司马班超以三十六人使西域，夜袭匈奴使者于鄯善（「不入虎穴，不得虎子」），鄯善、于阗皆降。「西域自绝六十五载，乃复通焉」。
snaps.te: Dou Gu beyond the frontier · Ban Chao in the west
snaps.de: In 69 King Liumao of Ailao submitted and Yongchang Commandery was set up, carrying Han territory west to the Irrawaddy. In Yongping 16 Dou Gu and Geng Zhong set out from Jiuquan, beat the Huyan king of the Northern Xiongnu in the Tianshan, pursued him to Lake Pulei and took the Yiwulu lands, where a Yihe commandant set up farming garrisons; Dou Gu sent his acting major Ban Chao with thirty-six men to the Western Regions; Ban Chao fell on the Xiongnu envoys at Shanshan by night ('if you do not enter the tiger's den, you cannot catch its cub'), and Shanshan and Khotan both submitted. 'The Western Regions, cut off for sixty-five years, were opened up once more.'

snaps.d: 永平十七年十一月，窦固、耿秉、刘张出敦煌昆仑塞，破北匈奴于蒲类海上，进入车师，车师后王安得、前王相继请降。于是复置西域都护、戊己校尉：陈睦为都护，耿恭、关宠分屯车师后部金蒲城、前部柳中城。班超已于是年春至疏勒，执龟兹所立的疏勒王兜题，立故王兄子忠。西域复通，是为三绝三通的第一通；惟龟兹、焉耆等北道诸国仍附北匈奴。
snaps.de: In the 11th month of Yongping 17 Dou Gu, Geng Bing and Liu Zhang set out from the Kunlun frontier post of Dunhuang, beat the Northern Xiongnu on the shore of Lake Pulei and entered Jushi, where An'de, the Rear King, and then the Front King surrendered. The Protector-General and the Wu-Ji colonels were then restored: Chen Mu became Protector-General, and Geng Gong and Guan Chong were stationed at Jinpu in the Rear Kingdom of Jushi and at Liuzhong in the Front Kingdom. That spring Ban Chao had reached Kashgar, seized Douti, the king Kucha had imposed there, and set up Zhong, a nephew of the former king. The Western Regions were reopened, the first of the 'three reopenings', though Kucha, Karasahr and the other northern-route states still sided with the Northern Xiongnu.

labe.69: Protectorate of the Western Regions (oasis states)
labe.70: Kucha and Karasahr (under the Northern Xiongnu)

snaps.t: 耿恭守疏勒·罢西域都护
snaps.d: 永平十八年三月北匈奴二万骑攻车师，耿恭移据车师后部疏勒城，匈奴断其涧水，恭穿井十五丈，拜井得泉；八月明帝崩，焉耆、龟兹攻没都护陈睦，北匈奴围关宠于柳中。建初元年正月，段彭等发张掖、酒泉、敦煌三郡及鄯善兵七千余人，破车师于交河城，关宠已没；范羌越天山迎耿恭，三月至玉门，生还者仅十三人。章帝不欲疲敝中国，罢都护与戊己校尉，次年又罢伊吾屯田，是为第二绝。班超奉诏东归，于阗王侯抱马脚号泣，超遂还疏勒坚守。
snaps.te: Geng Gong at the Shule fort · the Protectorate abandoned
snaps.de: In the 3rd month of Yongping 18 the Northern Xiongnu attacked Jushi with 20,000 horsemen. Geng Gong moved into the fort of Shule in the Rear Kingdom; the Xiongnu cut off its stream, and he dug a well fifteen zhang deep and found water by bowing to it. In the 8th month Emperor Ming died; Karasahr and Kucha attacked and killed the Protector-General Chen Mu, and the Northern Xiongnu besieged Guan Chong at Liuzhong. In the 1st month of Jianchu 1 Duan Peng and others, with more than 7,000 men from Zhangye, Jiuquan, Dunhuang and Shanshan, broke Jushi at Jiaohe, but Guan Chong was already dead; Fan Qiang crossed the Tianshan to bring Geng Gong out, and in the 3rd month only thirteen men reached the Jade Gate alive. Unwilling to exhaust China, Emperor Zhang abolished the Protector-General and the Wu-Ji colonels, and the next year gave up the Yiwu farming garrison too: the second break. Ban Chao was ordered home, but at Khotan the king and nobles clung weeping to his horse's legs, and he went back to hold Kashgar.

snaps.d: 北匈奴内乱饥疫，南单于请兵北伐。永元元年车骑将军窦宪、耿秉率汉军与南匈奴、羌胡骑出鸡鹿塞、满夷谷、稒阳塞，会于涿邪山，大破北单于于稽落山，降者二十余万人。窦宪登燕然山，命中护军班固作铭刻石而还。班超仍以疏勒、于阗为根据，87 年已发于阗诸国兵破莎车。

lab.70: 北道诸国·车师（附北匈奴）

snaps.de: The Northern Xiongnu were torn by strife, famine and plague, and the southern chanyu asked for troops to attack them. In Yongyuan 1 the General of Chariots and Cavalry Dou Xian and Geng Bing led Han troops with Southern Xiongnu, Qiang and Hu horsemen out by the Jilu frontier post, the Manyi Valley and the Guyang frontier post, joined forces at Mount Zhuoye and crushed the northern chanyu at Mount Jiluo, more than 200,000 people surrendering. Dou Xian climbed Mount Yanran and had his army protector Ban Gu compose an inscription carved on the rock before turning back. Ban Chao still held Kashgar and Khotan as his base, and in 87 had led the troops of Khotan and its neighbours to take Yarkand.

labe.70: Northern-route states and Jushi (under the Northern Xiongnu)

snaps.d: 永元二年窦宪遣兵复取伊吾；三年耿夔、任尚出居延塞，围北单于于金微山，大破之，北单于西走，不知所在。鲜卑转徙据其故地，匈奴余种十余万落皆自号鲜卑。龟兹、姑墨、温宿皆降，以班超为西域都护，居龟兹它乾城，西域复通，是为第二通。90 年贵霜副王谢率七万众攻班超，粮尽请和。
snaps.de: In Yongyuan 2 Dou Xian sent troops to retake Yiwu; in year 3 Geng Kui and Ren Shang came out by the Juyan frontier, surrounded the northern chanyu at the Jinwei Mountains and routed him, and he fled west to no one knew where. The Xianbei moved into his old lands, and more than a hundred thousand households of Xiongnu remnants called themselves Xianbei. Kucha, Gumo and Wensu all submitted, and Ban Chao was made Protector-General, based at Tuoqian in Kucha: the second reopening of the Western Regions. In 90 the Kushan viceroy Xie had attacked Ban Chao with 70,000 men but sued for peace when his supplies ran out.

labe.69: Protectorate of the Western Regions (oasis states)

snaps.d: 永元六年秋班超发龟兹、鄯善等八国兵七万余人，讨焉耆、危须、尉犁，斩焉耆王广，传首京师，更立元孟。「于是西域五十余国悉皆纳质内属」，东汉对西域的经营至于极盛。97 年班超遣甘英使大秦，抵条支海滨而还。（此节点原为汉末卷开篇）
snaps.de: In the autumn of Yongyuan 6 Ban Chao raised over 70,000 men from eight states including Kucha and Shanshan against Karasahr, Weixu and Yuli, beheaded Guang, king of Karasahr, sent his head to the capital and set up Yuanmeng in his place. 'Thereupon more than fifty states of the Western Regions all sent hostages and submitted': Eastern Han control of the Western Regions was at its height. In 97 Ban Chao sent Gan Ying towards Da Qin; he reached the shore of the sea of Tiaozhi and turned back. (This snapshot used to open the Late Han and the Three Kingdoms volume.)

labe.69: Protectorate of the Western Regions (oasis states)

snaps.d: 班超 102 年东归，继任都护任尚苛急失众，西域诸国反叛，围攻都护段禧。永初元年诏罢西域都护，迎还伊吾、柳中屯田吏士；北匈奴复收属诸国，共为边寇十余年，是为第三绝。同年征发羌骑赴西域，羌众溃散，先零羌滇零在北地自称天子，寇掠三辅、断陇道，汉军屡败，凉州大乱；111 年陇西、安定、北地、上郡四郡内迁。
snaps.te: The Protectorate abandoned · the Qiang war
snaps.de: Ban Chao went home in 102; his successor Ren Shang's harshness lost the states' loyalty, and they rose and besieged the Protector-General Duan Xi. In Yongchu 1 an edict abolished the Protectorate and recalled the farming garrisons of Yiwu and Liuzhong; the Northern Xiongnu took the states back under their control and raided the frontier with them for more than ten years: the third break. That year Qiang horsemen conscripted for the Western Regions deserted; Dianlian of the Xianlian Qiang proclaimed himself Son of Heaven in Beidi, raided the capital region and cut the road to Long, the Han armies were beaten again and again, and Liang Province fell into chaos; in 111 the commanderies of Longxi, Anding, Beidi and Shang were moved inland.

snaps.d: 118 年先零羌平，凉州稍安。123 年以班超之子班勇为西域长史，屯柳中，124—126 年破车师前后部，逐北匈奴呼衍王，鄯善、龟兹、姑墨、温宿诸国皆服。永建二年班勇与敦煌太守张朗讨焉耆，焉耆王元孟降，「于是龟兹、疏勒、于阗、莎车等十七国皆来服从」。《后汉书·西域传》：「自建武至于延光，西域三绝三通。」王莽时绝，永平十七年复置都护；建初元年罢都护，永元三年班超为都护；永初元年罢都护，延光二年班勇为长史。
snaps.de: The Xianlian Qiang were subdued in 118 and Liang Province grew quieter. In 123 Ban Chao's son Ban Yong was made Chief Clerk of the Western Regions, garrisoned at Liuzhong; in 124–126 he broke the front and rear kingdoms of Jushi and drove off the Huyan king of the Northern Xiongnu, and Shanshan, Kucha, Gumo and Wensu all submitted. In Yongjian 2 Ban Yong and Zhang Lang, Administrator of Dunhuang, attacked Karasahr; its king Yuanmeng surrendered, 'and Kucha, Kashgar, Khotan, Yarkand and seventeen states in all came to submit'. In the words of the Hou Han shu, 'from Jianwu to Yanguang, the Western Regions were three times cut off and three times reopened': cut off under Wang Mang and reopened when the Protectorate was restored in Yongping 17; cut off when it was abandoned in Jianchu 1 and reopened when Ban Chao became Protector-General in Yongyuan 3; cut off when it was abandoned in Yongchu 1 and reopened when Ban Yong became Chief Clerk in Yanguang 2.

labe.69: Chief Clerk of the Western Regions (oasis states)

snaps.d: 140—145 年羌乱再起，三辅、陇右残破。鲜卑檀石槐勇健有谋略，立庭于弹汗山歠仇水上，东西部大人皆归焉，南抄缘边，北拒丁零，东却夫余，西击乌孙，「尽据匈奴故地，东西万四千余里」。永寿二年寇云中，此后连年入塞。166 年起党锢之祸，宦官专权。
snaps.de: The Qiang rose again in 140–145, ravaging the capital region and Longyou. Tanshihuai of the Xianbei, brave and shrewd, set up his court on the Chuochou River below Mount Danhan; the chiefs of east and west all came over to him, and he raided the frontier to the south, held off the Dingling to the north, pushed back Buyeo to the east and struck at Wusun to the west, 'taking all the old Xiongnu lands, more than fourteen thousand li from east to west'. In Yongshou 2 he raided Yunzhong and thereafter crossed the frontier year after year. From 166 the Partisan Prohibitions began and the eunuchs held power.

labe.69: Chief Clerk of the Western Regions (oasis states)

snaps.d: 159 年起西羌、东羌复叛。护羌校尉段颎主剿，前后百八十战，斩首三万八千余级；建宁二年于射虎谷大破东羌，东羌悉平。是年第二次党锢，李膺等百余人死狱中。
snaps.te: Duan Jiong crushes the Eastern Qiang
snaps.de: The Western and Eastern Qiang rose again from 159. Duan Jiong, Protector of the Qiang, favoured extermination and in 180 engagements took more than 38,000 heads; in Jianning 2 he crushed the Eastern Qiang at Shehu Valley and they were wholly subdued. That year saw the second Partisan Prohibition, in which Li Ying and more than a hundred others died in prison.

snaps.d: 鲜卑连年寇边，幽、并、凉三州无岁不被其害。熹平六年八月遣夏育出高柳、田晏出云中、臧旻率南单于出雁门，各将万骑，三道出塞二千余里；檀石槐命三部大人迎战，汉军大败，丧其节传辎重，各将数十骑奔还，死者十七八。
snaps.de: The Xianbei raided the frontier every year, and You, Bing and Liang provinces suffered without respite. In the 8th month of Xiping 6 Xia Yu set out from Gaoliu, Tian Yan from Yunzhong and Zang Min with the southern chanyu from Yanmen, each with ten thousand horsemen, three columns striking more than two thousand li beyond the frontier; Tanshihuai sent the chiefs of his three divisions against them, and the Han armies were routed, losing their credentials and baggage, each general fleeing back with a few dozen riders and seven or eight in ten of the men killed.

snaps.d: 灵帝中平元年二月，张角以太平道聚众数十万，三十六方同日起事，头裹黄巾，七州二十八郡响应，以冀州巨鹿、豫州颍川、汝南与荆州南阳最盛。朝廷解除党锢，以皇甫嵩、朱儁、卢植分讨：五月长社火攻破波才，宛城围攻张曼成余部历时数月，十月广宗破张梁，十一月下曲阳斩张宝，主力平定。冬，湟中义从胡与北宫伯玉、边章、韩遂起兵凉州，枹罕宋建自称“河首平汉王”。
snaps.de: In the 2nd month of Zhongping 1 under Emperor Ling, Zhang Jue, who had gathered several hundred thousand followers through the Way of Great Peace, rose in thirty-six divisions on the same day, his men wearing yellow turbans. Twenty-eight commanderies in seven provinces responded, most strongly Julu in Ji Province, Yingchuan and Runan in Yu Province, and Nanyang in Jing Province. The court lifted the Partisan Prohibitions and sent Huangfu Song, Zhu Jun and Lu Zhi against them: in the 5th month they burned out Bo Cai at Changshe; the siege of Zhang Mancheng's remnant at Wancheng lasted several months; in the 10th month Zhang Liang was crushed at Guangzong, and in the 11th month Zhang Bao was beheaded at Xiaquyang, ending the main rising. In winter the Huangzhong Auxiliary Hu rose in Liang Province with Beigong Boyu, Bian Zhang and Han Sui, and Song Jian of Fuhan styled himself "King of the River's Source who Pacifies Han".

zhoue.西域都护（城郭诸国）: Protectorate of the Western Regions (oasis states)
zhoue.西域长史（城郭诸国）: Chief Clerk of the Western Regions (oasis states)

pe: Camp of the Wise King of the Right

units.note: 前221 年秦王政灭六国，称始皇帝，分天下为三十六郡，后增至四十余郡；书同文、车同轨，统一度量衡。北逐匈奴、南取百越，筑长城、修驰道直道。前210 年始皇崩于沙丘，赵高、李斯矫诏立胡亥；前209 年陈胜起事，前207 年子婴降刘邦，秦亡（通鉴系于汉元年十月，即前206 年）。
units.notee: In 221 BC King Zheng of Qin destroyed the six states, took the title First Emperor and divided the realm into thirty-six commanderies, later more than forty; he standardised the script, axle widths, weights and measures. Qin drove the Xiongnu north and conquered the Hundred Yue, building the Great Wall, the imperial highways and the Straight Road. The First Emperor died at Shaqiu in 210 BC and Zhao Gao and Li Si forged his will to enthrone Huhai; Chen Sheng rose in 209 BC, and Ziying surrendered to Liu Bang in 207 BC, ending Qin (dated by the Tongjian to the 10th month of Han year 1, i.e. 206 BC).

units.note: 秦并天下后唯卫君角仍守野王一隅，前209 年被秦二世废为庶人，卫绝祀。
units.notee: After the Qin unification only Lord Jue of Wey still held a corner around Yewang; in 209 BC the Second Emperor deposed him, making him a commoner, and the line of Wey came to an end.

units.note: 前209 年七月陈胜、吴广起于大泽乡，陈胜据陈称王，国号张楚，遣诸将四出略地；当年冬周文西攻至戏，败还。前208 年十二月陈胜为庄贾所杀，张楚瓦解。
units.notee: In the 7th month of 209 BC Chen Sheng and Wu Guang rose at Dazexiang; Chen Sheng took Chen and proclaimed himself king of Zhang Chu, sending his generals out in all directions to seize territory. That winter Zhou Wen advanced west as far as Xi before being driven back. In the 12th month of 208 BC Chen Sheng was murdered by Zhuang Jia and Zhang Chu collapsed.

units.note: 项梁、项羽起兵会稽，前208 年六月于盱台立楚怀王之孙心为楚王（仍号怀王），号令诸侯。巨鹿之战后诸侯将皆属项羽；前206 年正月项羽尊怀王为义帝，二月自立为西楚霸王。
units.notee: Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu raised troops at Kuaiji, and in the 6th month of 208 BC at Xuyi set up Xin, grandson of King Huai of Chu, as king of Chu (still styled King Huai), to command the allied lords. After Julu all the allied generals came under Xiang Yu; in the 1st month of 206 BC Xiang Yu honoured King Huai as Righteous Emperor, and in the 2nd month made himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu.

units.note: 项羽自立为西楚霸王，王梁楚九郡，都彭城，分封十八王。前205 年彭城一战大破汉军，与汉相持于荥阳、成皋；前203 年鸿沟议和，次年垓下败亡，楚地皆降。
units.notee: Xiang Yu made himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu, ruling nine commanderies of Liang and Chu from Pengcheng, and enfeoffed eighteen kings. In 205 BC he routed the Han army at Pengcheng and held Han at bay around Xingyang and Chenggao; after the Honggou Canal truce of 203 BC he was defeated at Gaixia and died the following year and the Chu lands submitted.

units.note: 前209 年八月武臣自立为赵王，旋为部将所杀；张耳、陈余立赵歇为王，都信都（襄国）。巨鹿之战前与张耳被秦军围于巨鹿城。分封后赵歇徙为代王，陈余逐张耳、迎赵歇复王赵；前204 年韩信破赵于井陉，斩陈余，擒赵歇。
units.notee: In the 8th month of 209 BC Wu Chen made himself king of Zhao and was soon killed by one of his generals; Zhang Er and Chen Yu then set up Zhao Xie as king at Xindu (Xiangguo); before the battle of Julu he and Zhang Er were besieged by Qin in the city of Julu. At the enfeoffment Zhao Xie was moved to Dai, but Chen Yu drove out Zhang Er and brought him back as king of Zhao; in 204 BC Han Xin broke Zhao at Jingxing, beheading Chen Yu and capturing Zhao Xie.

units.note: 前209 年田儋自立为齐王；田儋战死后田荣立田市。分封时项羽三分齐地，田荣不服，并三齐自立；田荣死后其弟田横立田广。前203 年韩信破齐，田广被俘，田横逃入海岛。
units.notee: In 209 BC Tian Dan made himself king of Qi; after he fell in battle Tian Rong set up Tian Shi. Xiang Yu split Qi in three at the enfeoffment, but Tian Rong refused to accept it and took all three for himself; after his death his brother Tian Heng set up Tian Guang. In 203 BC Han Xin conquered Qi, Tian Guang was captured and Tian Heng fled to an island.

units.note: 前209 年韩广自立为燕王。分封时项羽以燕将臧荼为燕王、徙韩广为辽东王，臧荼随即击杀韩广，并辽东。前204 年降汉；前202 年反，被擒，卢绾继为燕王。
units.notee: Han Guang made himself king of Yan in 209 BC. At the enfeoffment Xiang Yu made the Yan general Zang Tu king of Yan and moved Han Guang to Liaodong, whereupon Zang Tu killed Han Guang and annexed Liaodong. Yan submitted to Han in 204 BC; Zang Tu rebelled in 202 BC and was captured, and Lu Wan became king of Yan.

units.note: 前209 年魏咎被立为魏王，都临济；前208 年章邯破临济，魏咎自焚。其弟魏豹复得魏地，分封时被徙为西魏王（见「西魏」）。
units.notee: Wei Jiu was set up as king of Wei at Linji in 209 BC; when Zhang Han took Linji in 208 BC, Wei Jiu burned himself to death. His brother Wei Bao recovered the Wei lands and at the enfeoffment was moved to be king of Western Wei (see Western Wei).

units.note: 前208 年项梁立韩国公子成为韩王，张良为司徒，略取韩地。分封时韩成不得就国，为项羽所杀；后韩王信（韩襄王孙）随汉定韩地，前205 年立为韩王。
units.notee: In 208 BC Xiang Liang made Prince Cheng of the old Han royal house king of Han (韓), with Zhang Liang as minister, to win back the Han lands. At the enfeoffment Han Cheng was not allowed to go to his kingdom and was killed by Xiang Yu; later Han Xin (a grandson of King Xiang of Han (韓), not the general Han Xin), fighting for Liu Bang, took the Han (韓) lands and was made king of Han (韓) in 205 BC.

units.note: 前206 年二月刘邦受封为汉王，王巴蜀汉中，都南郑；同年八月还定三秦，前202 年灭项羽，即皇帝位，都长安。汉承秦制而郡国并行：王国自置官吏，七国之乱后削藩、推恩，王国渐与郡同。武帝北逐匈奴、通西域，南平南越、西南夷，东灭朝鲜，疆域大拓。9 年王莽代汉；25 年刘秀称帝，都洛阳（东汉），36 年复一统。
units.notee: Liu Bang was enfeoffed as king of Han in the 2nd month of 206 BC, ruling Ba, Shu and Hanzhong from Nanzheng; that 8th month he retook the Three Qins, and in 202 BC, having destroyed Xiang Yu, he took the imperial title with his capital at Chang'an. Han kept the Qin system but ran commanderies and kingdoms side by side: kings appointed their own officials until, after the Rebellion of the Seven States, as the kingdoms were cut back and then divided under the Edict of Grace, they became little different from commanderies. Emperor Wu drove back the Xiongnu, opened the Western Regions, conquered Nanyue and the Southwestern peoples and destroyed Joseon, greatly enlarging the empire. Wang Mang took the throne in AD 9; Liu Xiu proclaimed himself emperor in 25 with his capital at Luoyang (Eastern Han) and reunited the realm in 36.

units.note: 秦降将章邯，前206 年受封为雍王，王咸阳以西，都废丘。同年八月刘邦还定三秦，章邯困守废丘，前205 年城破自杀。
units.notee: Zhang Han, the surrendered Qin general, was made king of Yong in 206 BC, ruling the land west of Xianyang from Feiqiu. When Liu Bang retook the Three Qins that 8th month Zhang Han was besieged in Feiqiu, and killed himself when it fell in 205 BC.

units.note: 秦降将司马欣，前206 年受封为塞王，王咸阳以东至河，都栎阳；同年降汉。
units.notee: Sima Xin, a surrendered Qin general, was made king of Sai in 206 BC, ruling from Xianyang east to the Yellow River with his capital at Yueyang; he submitted to Han the same year.

units.note: 秦降将董翳，前206 年受封为翟王，王上郡，都高奴；同年降汉。
units.notee: Dong Yi, a surrendered Qin general, was made king of Di in 206 BC, ruling Shang Commandery from Gaonu; he submitted to Han the same year.

units.note: 前206 年魏豹徙封西魏王，王河东，都平阳。前205 年从汉伐楚，彭城败后叛汉；同年九月韩信木罂渡河，虏魏豹，置河东、太原、上党郡。
units.notee: Wei Bao was moved to be king of Western Wei in 206 BC, ruling Hedong from Pingyang. In 205 BC he joined Han against Chu but turned against Han after Pengcheng; that 9th month Han Xin crossed the Yellow River on wooden jars and captured him, and Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang became commanderies.

units.note: 赵将申阳先下河南，前206 年受封为河南王，都洛阳；前205 年降汉，以其地为河南郡。
units.notee: Shen Yang, a Zhao general who had first taken Henan, was made king of Henan in 206 BC with his capital at Luoyang; he submitted to Han in 205 BC and his land became Henan Commandery.

units.note: 赵将司马卬定河内，前206 年受封为殷王，都朝歌。前205 年汉虏司马卬，以其地为河内郡。
units.notee: Sima Ang, a Zhao general who had taken Henei, was made king of Yin in 206 BC with his capital at Zhaoge. Han captured him in 205 BC and made his land Henei Commandery.

units.note: 前206 年赵歇徙为代王；陈余迎赵歇复王赵，赵歇立陈余为代王，陈余留赵辅政，使夏说守代。前205 年后九月韩信破代，擒夏说。
units.notee: Zhao Xie was moved to be king of Dai in 206 BC; when Chen Yu brought him back to Zhao, Zhao Xie made Chen Yu king of Dai; Chen Yu stayed at Zhao Xie's side and left Xia Yue to hold Dai. Han Xin broke Dai and captured Xia Yue in the intercalary 9th month of 205 BC.

units.note: 前206 年张耳受封为常山王，王赵地，都襄国；前205 年陈余袭破之，张耳奔汉。
units.notee: Zhang Er was made king of Changshan in 206 BC, ruling the Zhao lands from Xiangguo; Chen Yu attacked and broke him in 205 BC and Zhang Er fled to Han.

units.note: 楚将英布（黥布），前206 年受封为九江王，都六。前204 年归汉，九江之地为项羽所并；前203 年改封淮南王。
units.notee: Ying Bu (Qing Bu), a Chu general, was made king of Jiujiang in 206 BC with his capital at Lu. He went over to Han in 204 BC and Xiang Yu took his land; in 203 BC he was re-enfeoffed as king of Huainan.

units.note: 番君吴芮，前206 年受封为衡山王，都邾。前202 年徙为长沙王。
units.notee: Wu Rui, Lord of Po, was made king of Hengshan in 206 BC with his capital at Zhu. In 202 BC he was moved to be king of Changsha.

units.note: 楚柱国共敖，前206 年受封为临江王，都江陵；其子共尉嗣立，前202 年汉虏之。
units.notee: Gong Ao, a pillar of state of Chu, was made king of Linjiang in 206 BC with his capital at Jiangling; his son Gong Wei succeeded him and was captured by Han in 202 BC.

units.note: 前206 年韩广由燕王徙为辽东王，都无终；不肯就国，同年为臧荼所杀，辽东并于燕。
units.notee: In 206 BC Han Guang was moved from Yan to be king of Liaodong at Wuzhong; he refused to go and was killed by Zang Tu the same year, Liaodong passing to Yan.

units.note: 前206 年田市徙为胶东王，都即墨；田荣怒而击杀之。
units.notee: Tian Shi was moved to be king of Jiaodong at Jimo in 206 BC; Tian Rong, enraged, attacked and killed him.

units.note: 齐将田安，前206 年受封为济北王，都博阳；同年为田荣所杀。
units.notee: Tian An, a Qi general, was made king of Jibei at Boyang in 206 BC and killed by Tian Rong the same year.

units.note: 王莽以外戚辅政，元始年间封安汉公、宰衡；8 年十二月称帝，国号新，改元始建国（9）。托古改制：王田、私属，五均六筦，屡改币制与郡县名，又贬四夷王号，与匈奴、西域、高句丽失和。17 年起绿林、赤眉相继而起，23 年昆阳大败，长安城破，王莽被杀。
units.notee: Wang Mang ruled for the Han court as an imperial in-law, being made Duke Who Secures the Han and Chief Steward in the Yuanshi years; in the 12th month of AD 8 he took the throne, naming his dynasty Xin with the era Shijianguo (AD 9). His reforms, modelled on antiquity, nationalised land and banned the sale of slaves, set up state monopolies and price controls, repeatedly changed the coinage and the names of commanderies and counties, and demoted the rulers of the neighbouring peoples, falling out with the Xiongnu, the Western Regions and Goguryeo. The Lülin and Red Eyebrows rose from 17; after the disaster at Kunyang in 23 Chang'an fell and Wang Mang was killed.

units.note: 绿林军拥立的汉宗室刘玄，23 年二月称帝，年号更始；昆阳之战后入洛阳、长安。25 年赤眉入长安，更始降，旋被杀。
units.notee: Liu Xuan, a member of the Han royal clan raised up by the Lülin army, proclaimed himself emperor in the 2nd month of AD 23 with the era name Gengshi, and after Kunyang entered Luoyang and Chang'an. When the Red Eyebrows took Chang'an in 25 he surrendered and was soon killed.

units.note: 琅邪人樊崇等 18 年起于莒，以朱涂眉为号。25 年立刘盆子为帝，入长安；27 年粮尽东归，降刘秀于宜阳。
units.notee: Fan Chong and others from Langya rose at Ju in AD 18, painting their eyebrows red to mark themselves. In 25 they set up Liu Penzi as emperor and entered Chang'an; in 27, out of food, they turned east and surrendered to Liu Xiu at Yiyang.

units.note: 天水隗嚣 23 年起兵，据陇右，称西州上将军，先附更始、后附刘秀，30 年反汉，31 年称臣公孙述。33 年病死，34 年其子隗纯降。
units.notee: Wei Xiao of Tianshui rose in AD 23 and held Longyou as Supreme General of the Western Province, submitting first to Gengshi and then to Liu Xiu; in 30 he turned against Han, and in 31 declared himself a vassal of Gongsun Shu. He died of illness in 33 and his son Wei Chun surrendered in 34.

units.note: 导江卒正公孙述 25 年在成都称帝，国号成家，据巴蜀。36 年吴汉攻破成都，公孙述伤重而死。
units.notee: Gongsun Shu, governor of Daojiang, proclaimed himself emperor at Chengdu in AD 25, naming his state Chengjia and holding Ba and Shu. Wu Han took Chengdu in 36 and Gongsun Shu died of his wounds.

units.note: 梁王刘永 25 年在睢阳称帝，据梁、楚、沛之地；27 年败死，其子刘纡 29 年覆灭。
units.notee: Liu Yong, king of Liang, proclaimed himself emperor at Suiyang in AD 25, holding Liang, Chu and Pei; he was defeated and killed in 27, and his son Liu Yu was wiped out in 29.

units.note: 琅邪张步据齐地十二郡，受刘永封为齐王；29 年耿弇破之于临淄，张步降。
units.notee: Zhang Bu of Langya held twelve commanderies of Qi and was made king of Qi by Liu Yong; Geng Yan broke him at Linzi in AD 29 and he surrendered.

units.note: 董宪据东海郯县，受刘永封为海西王；30 年败死。
units.notee: Dong Xian held Tan in Donghai and was made king of Haixi by Liu Yong; he was defeated and killed in AD 30.

units.note: 渔阳太守彭宠 26 年反于渔阳，27 年自立为燕王；29 年为奴所杀。
units.notee: Peng Chong, governor of Yuyang, rebelled in AD 26 and made himself king of Yan in 27; he was murdered by his slaves in 29.

units.note: 秦丰据南郡黎丘，自号楚黎王；29 年降，被杀。
units.notee: Qin Feng held Liqiu in Nan Commandery as King of Chu-Li; he surrendered and was executed in AD 29.

units.note: 庐江李宪据舒称淮南王，后称帝；30 年败死。
units.notee: Li Xian of Lujiang held the city of Shu (in Lujiang) as king of Huainan and later as emperor; he was defeated and killed in AD 30.

units.note: 安定卢芳诈称汉武帝曾孙刘文伯，在匈奴支持下据五原、朔方、云中、定襄、雁门五郡，29 年称帝于九原；40 年降汉，旋复入匈奴。
units.notee: Lu Fang of Anding, falsely claiming to be Liu Wenbo, a great-grandson of Emperor Wu, held the five commanderies of Wuyuan, Shuofang, Yunzhong, Dingxiang and Yanmen with Xiongnu support and proclaimed himself emperor at Jiuyuan in AD 29; he surrendered to Han in 40 but soon went back to the Xiongnu.

units.note: 更始时窦融为张掖属国都尉，据河西五郡，号河西大将军，保境安民；29 年归附刘秀，36 年入朝，河西归东汉。
units.notee: Under Gengshi Dou Rong was commandant of the Zhangye Dependent State and held the five commanderies of Hexi as Grand General of Hexi, keeping the region at peace; he submitted to Liu Xiu in AD 29 and went to court in 36, and Hexi passed to the Eastern Han.

units.note: 巨鹿人张角以太平道传教十余年，信众数十万，分三十六方。184 年二月以「苍天已死，黄天当立」为号同日起事，七州二十八郡响应。
units.notee: Zhang Jue of Julu spent more than ten years spreading the Way of Great Peace, gaining hundreds of thousands of followers organised in thirty-six divisions. In the 2nd month of 184 they rose on a single day under the slogan "The Blue Heaven is dead; the Yellow Heaven shall rise", with twenty-eight commanderies in seven provinces responding.

units.note: 184 年冬北地先零羌与枹罕、河关群盗反，劫持边章、韩遂，攻杀金城太守，凉州大乱。
units.notee: In the winter of 184 the Xianlian Qiang of Beidi and bandits of Fuhan and Heguan rose, seized Bian Zhang and Han Sui, and killed the governor of Jincheng, throwing Liang Province into chaos.

units.note: 枹罕宋建 184 年乘凉州之乱自立，号河首平汉王，割据三十余年。
units.notee: Song Jian of Fuhan took advantage of the disorder in Liang Province in 184 to set himself up as King of the Yellow River's Head Who Pacifies Han, holding out for more than thirty years.

units.note: 秦时头曼单于居漠南，前214 年为蒙恬所逐。前209 年冒顿杀父自立，东灭东胡，西走月氏，南并楼烦、白羊，北服丁零、坚昆，控弦三十余万，前200 年围汉高祖于白登。汉初和亲；武帝时屡遭重创，远遁漠北。前57 年五单于争立，后分为呼韩邪、郅支两部；呼韩邪称臣于汉。48 年再分南北。
units.notee: Under Qin the chanyu Touman lived south of the Gobi until Meng Tian drove him out in 214 BC. In 209 BC Modu killed his father and took power; he destroyed the Donghu to the east, drove off the Yuezhi to the west, absorbed the Loufan and Baiyang to the south and subdued the Dingling and Jiankun to the north, commanding over 300,000 archers, and in 200 BC besieged Emperor Gaozu of Han at Baideng. Early Han bought peace with marriage alliances; under Emperor Wu the Xiongnu suffered heavy defeats and withdrew north of the Gobi. In 57 BC five chanyus contended and the Xiongnu split between Huhanye and Zhizhi, Huhanye becoming a Han vassal. In AD 48 they split again into north and south.

units.note: 五单于争立中，呼韩邪单于为郅支所败，前53 年遣子入侍，前51 年亲朝甘泉宫，称臣于汉，居光禄塞下；前43 年北归单于庭。
units.notee: Defeated by Zhizhi in the struggle of the five chanyus, Huhanye sent his son to serve at the Han court in 53 BC, came in person to the Ganquan Palace in 51 BC and declared himself a Han vassal, living near the Guanglu Fort; he returned north to the chanyu's court in 43 BC.

units.note: 郅支单于据漠北，前49 年西击坚昆、乌揭，徙居坚昆；前44 年杀汉使，西投康居，筑郅支城于都赖水。前36 年陈汤、甘延寿发西域兵攻杀之。
units.notee: The chanyu Zhizhi held the north of the Gobi; in 49 BC he struck west at the Jiankun and Wujie and moved to the Jiankun lands, and in 44 BC, having killed a Han envoy, went west to Kangju and built a fortress on the Talas. In 36 BC Chen Tang and Gan Yanshou raised the forces of the Western Regions and killed him.

units.note: 48 年匈奴分裂，蒲奴单于据漠北，是为北匈奴。73 年起汉屡出击，89 年窦宪破之于稽落山，91 年北单于西遁，余部或降鲜卑；残部活动于蒲类、伊吾一带，屡寇西域。
units.notee: When the Xiongnu split in AD 48 the chanyu Punu held the north of the Gobi: these were the Northern Xiongnu. Han attacked them repeatedly from 73; Dou Xian crushed them at Mount Jiluo in 89, and in 91 the northern chanyu fled west, many of his people joining the Xianbei, while remnants roamed around Pulei and Yiwu, raiding the Western Regions.

units.note: 48 年匈奴南边八部共立日逐王比为呼韩邪单于，附汉，是为南匈奴。50 年入居西河美稷，汉置使匈奴中郎将监护；单于遣诸部分屯北地、朔方、五原、云中、定襄、雁门、代郡，为汉守边。89—91 年随窦宪击破北匈奴。此后一直作为内属部族居于北边诸郡，188 年单于羌渠为国人所杀，其子於夫罗流寓河东；216 年曹操分其众为五部。图上 50 年以后画作内属于汉（斜线）。
units.notee: In AD 48 the eight southern Xiongnu tribes made Bi, the Rizhu king, chanyu with the title Huhanye; he submitted to Han, and these were the Southern Xiongnu. In 50 they settled at Meiji in Xihe under a Han General of the Household Sent to the Xiongnu, and the chanyu stationed his tribes in Beidi, Shuofang, Wuyuan, Yunzhong, Dingxiang, Yanmen and Dai to guard the frontier for Han. In 89–91 they fought beside Dou Xian to crush the Northern Xiongnu. From then on they lived inside the northern commanderies as a dependent people; in 188 the chanyu Qiangqu was killed by his own people and his son Yufuluo was stranded in Hedong, and in 216 Cao Cao divided them into five divisions. From 50 the map shows them as nominally submitted to Han (hatched).

units.note: 单于直辖之地。《史记·匈奴列传》：「单于之庭直代、云中。」前123 年单于用赵信计「益北绝幕」，王庭北移；前119 年漠北之战后「漠南无王庭」。前105 年儿单于立，「自此之后，单于益西北，左方兵直云中，右方直酒泉、燉煌郡」，图上自前101 年起三部整体西移，漠南、漠北的西部改归单于本部。王庭所在史无确地，图上前123 年北迁以前标在漠南（「直代、云中」），此后标在鄂尔浑河中游，都只是大致；各部之间也无明界，沿山川示意。
units.notee: Land under the chanyu's direct rule. The Shiji says the chanyu's court lay opposite Dai and Yunzhong; in 123 BC, on Zhao Xin's advice, the chanyu moved 'further north across the Gobi', and after the battle beyond the Gobi (119 BC) 'there was no royal court south of the Gobi'. After the boy chanyu came to the throne in 105 BC, 'the chanyu moved further north-west; the forces of the left faced Yunzhong and those of the right faced Jiuquan and Dunhuang', so from the 101 BC snapshot the map shifts all three divisions west and gives the western parts north and south of the Gobi to the chanyu's own domain. The sources fix no site for the court, so the map's placement of it south of the Gobi ('facing Dai and Yunzhong') until the move north in 123 BC and on the middle Orkhon after that is only approximate; nor do they give borders between the divisions, which the map draws along mountains and rivers as a sketch.

units.note: 匈奴左方（东方）诸王将之地，左贤王常为单于储副。《史记·匈奴列传》：「诸左方王将居东方，直上谷以往者，东接秽貉、朝鲜。」前119 年霍去病出代郡破左贤王，封狼居胥山。前105 年以后「左方兵直云中」，图上自前101 年起左方西展到云中以北的漠南。界线为示意。
units.notee: Land of the kings and generals of the Xiongnu left (east); the Wise King of the Left was usually the chanyu's heir. The Shiji says they lived in the east, opposite Shanggu and beyond, bordering the Ye-Maek and Joseon. In 119 BC Huo Qubing set out from Dai, defeated the Wise King of the Left and sacrificed on Mount Langjuxu. After 105 BC 'the forces of the left faced Yunzhong', so from the 101 BC snapshot the left extends west to the land north of Yunzhong, south of the Gobi. The borders are a sketch.

units.note: 匈奴右方（西方）诸王将之地。《史记·匈奴列传》：「右方王将居西方，直上郡以西，接月氏、氐、羌。」前124 年卫青出高阙，夜围右贤王，右贤王仅以身免。前105 年以后「右方直酒泉、燉煌郡」，图上自前101 年起右方西移，只留阿尔泰山与天山以北。界线为示意。
units.notee: Land of the kings and generals of the Xiongnu right (west). The Shiji says they lived in the west, opposite Shang Commandery and westward, bordering the Yuezhi, the Di and the Qiang. In 124 BC Wei Qing marched out through Gaoque and surrounded the Wise King of the Right by night; the king escaped with only his life. After 105 BC 'the right faced Jiuquan and Dunhuang', so from the 101 BC snapshot the right moves west and keeps only the Altai and the land north of the Tianshan. The borders are a sketch.

units.note: 河西走廊西部，属匈奴右方。《汉书·地理志》张掖郡下：「故匈奴昆邪王地。」昆邪即浑邪。前121 年霍去病两击河西后，浑邪王杀休屠王，率众四万余人降汉。
units.notee: The western Hexi Corridor, part of the Xiongnu right. The Han shu Treatise on Geography notes under Zhangye that it was 'formerly the land of the Xiongnu Kunye king' (Kunye being Hunye). After Huo Qubing's two strikes into Hexi in 121 BC the Hunye king killed the Xiutu king and surrendered to Han with over 40,000 people.

units.note: 河西走廊东部，属匈奴右方。《汉书·地理志》武威郡下：「故匈奴休屠王地。」前121 年霍去病获休屠王祭天金人；同年休屠王欲降而悔，为浑邪王所杀，其子金日磾入汉。
units.notee: The eastern Hexi Corridor, part of the Xiongnu right. The Han shu Treatise on Geography notes under Wuwei that it was 'formerly the land of the Xiongnu Xiutu king'. In 121 BC Huo Qubing took the golden statue the Xiutu king used to worship Heaven; that year the king, having agreed to surrender, changed his mind and was killed by the Hunye king, and his son Jin Midi went to Han.

units.note: 河南地（河套）的楼烦王、白羊王。前209 年后匈奴乘秦末之乱复度河南；前127 年卫青取河南，「走白羊、楼烦王」，置朔方、五原郡。
units.notee: The Loufan and Baiyang kings of the Ordos, the land 'south of the River' inside the Yellow River bend. The Xiongnu crossed back into the Ordos in the chaos after 209 BC; in 127 BC Wei Qing took the Ordos, 'driving off the Baiyang and Loufan kings', and set up Shuofang and Wuyuan commanderies.

units.note: 王莽末至建武年间，单于舆以比为右薁鞬日逐王，部领匈奴南边八部及乌桓（《后汉书·南匈奴列传》）。48 年八部共立比为呼韩邪单于，即南匈奴。
units.ne: Eight southern tribes (Bi, the Rizhu king)
units.notee: Under the chanyu Yu (from the end of Wang Mang's reign into the Jianwu era) Bi was the Right Yujian Rizhu king, in charge of the eight southern Xiongnu tribes and the Wuhuan (Hou Han shu, Southern Xiongnu). In AD 48 the eight tribes made Bi chanyu as Huhanye: these became the Southern Xiongnu.

units.note: 北单于直辖的漠北之地，王庭在今蒙古国杭爱山东麓一带。89 年窦宪破之于稽落山，91 年耿夔围北单于于金微山，北单于西遁。界线为示意。
units.notee: The land north of the Gobi under the northern chanyu's direct rule, with his court around the eastern foot of the Khangai Mountains. Dou Xian crushed him at Mount Jiluo in 89, and in 91 Geng Kui surrounded him at the Jinwei Mountains and he fled west. The borders are a sketch.

units.note: 北匈奴西部的呼衍氏贵种，常在蒲类海（今巴里坤湖）一带游牧，控制车师、伊吾，屡寇西域（《后汉书·西域传》）。73 年窦固破之于天山，124 年后班勇屡与之争车师。界线为示意。
units.notee: The noble Huyan clan in the west of the Northern Xiongnu lands, who roamed around Lake Pulei (Lake Barkol), controlled Jushi and Yiwu and raided the Western Regions again and again (Hou Han shu, Western Regions). Dou Gu beat them in the Tianshan in 73, and from 124 Ban Yong fought them repeatedly for Jushi. The borders are a sketch.

units.note: 战国以来居燕北的游牧部族，秦末强盛，向冒顿索宝马、阏氏与弃地；前206 年为冒顿所灭，余众退保乌桓山、鲜卑山，分为乌桓、鲜卑。
units.notee: Nomads living north of Yan since the Warring States, the Donghu grew strong at the end of Qin and demanded of Modu his best horse, his consort and the empty land between them; Modu destroyed them in 206 BC, and the survivors withdrew to the Wuhuan and Xianbei mountains, becoming the Wuhuan and the Xianbei.

units.note: 东胡余部，居乌桓山，役属匈奴。前119 年汉破匈奴左地，徙乌桓于上谷、渔阳、右北平、辽西、辽东五郡塞外，置护乌桓校尉。49 年入居塞内。
units.notee: Remnants of the Donghu living around the Wuhuan Mountains and subject to the Xiongnu. After Han broke the Xiongnu left wing in 119 BC the Wuhuan were moved beyond the frontier of the five commanderies from Shanggu to Liaodong under a Protector of the Wuhuan. In AD 49 they moved inside the frontier.

units.note: 东胡余部，居鲜卑山（大兴安岭）。东汉初渐南下，北匈奴西遁后尽据其地，余众十余万落自号鲜卑。156 年前后檀石槐统一诸部，分东、中、西三部，东接夫余、西接乌孙，177 年大败汉军。
units.notee: Remnants of the Donghu living in the Xianbei Mountains (the Greater Khingan). They moved south in the early Eastern Han, and after the Northern Xiongnu fled west took over all their land, more than a hundred thousand Xiongnu households calling themselves Xianbei. Around 156 Tanshihuai united the tribes in eastern, central and western divisions reaching from Buyeo to Wusun, and in 177 he routed a Han army.

units.note: 秦汉之际居敦煌、祁连间，一度强于匈奴。前176 年前后为冒顿所破，大部西迁伊犁，称大月氏；余众入南山羌中，为小月氏。
units.notee: At the end of Qin the Yuezhi lived between Dunhuang and the Qilian Mountains and were once stronger than the Xiongnu. Around 176 BC Modu defeated them; most moved west to the Ili valley as the Great Yuezhi, while the rest went into the Qiang lands of the Southern Mountains as the Lesser Yuezhi.

units.note: 月氏西迁伊犁后，前130 年前后又为乌孙所逐，南下妫水（阿姆河），臣服大夏，都妫水北，后居蓝市城。张骞前128 年至此，欲结之共击匈奴，不得要领。分五翕侯，1 世纪贵霜翕侯统一诸部。
units.notee: After moving to the Ili valley the Yuezhi were driven out again by the Wusun around 130 BC and went south to the Oxus (Amu Darya), subduing Daxia (Bactria) and making their court north of the river, later at Lanshi. Zhang Qian reached them in 128 BC hoping to ally against the Xiongnu, without success. They were divided among five yabghus, and in the 1st century AD the Kushan yabghu united them.

units.note: 居伊犁河、楚河流域的游牧部族（Saka）。前176 年前后为西迁的月氏所逐，南下葱岭，一部入罽宾。
units.notee: Nomads of the Ili and Chu valleys. Driven out by the westward-moving Yuezhi around 176 BC, they went south over the Pamirs, some reaching Jibin.

units.note: 本与月氏同居敦煌、祁连间。昆莫猎骄靡长于匈奴，前130 年前后西击大月氏，据伊犁河谷，都赤谷城。武帝以细君、解忧公主和亲，前71 年与汉夹击匈奴；前53 年分大小昆弥，西域都护护之。
units.notee: The Wusun once lived beside the Yuezhi between Dunhuang and the Qilian Mountains. Their kunmo Liejiaomi, raised among the Xiongnu, attacked the Great Yuezhi around 130 BC and took the Ili valley, with his court at Chigu. Emperor Wu sent the princesses Xijun and Jieyou as brides; in 71 BC Wusun and Han attacked the Xiongnu together, and in 53 BC the realm was split between a greater and a lesser kunmi, both under the Protector-General.

units.note: 费尔干纳盆地的城郭之国，都贵山城，产汗血马。前104—前101 年李广利两伐大宛，立亲汉的昧蔡为王，西域震动。
units.notee: A city-state of the Ferghana basin with its capital at Guishan, famed for its 'blood-sweating' horses. Li Guangli's two campaigns of 104–101 BC installed the pro-Han Meicai as king and shook the Western Regions.

units.note: 锡尔河中下游与塔什干一带的游牧之国，冬居乐越匿地，夏居卑阗城。郅支单于曾西投康居，筑城都赖水。东汉时并有粟特诸城。
units.notee: A nomadic state of the middle and lower Syr Darya and the Tashkent region, wintering at Leyueni and summering at Beitian. The chanyu Zhizhi took refuge with Kangju and built his fortress on the Talas. In the Eastern Han Kangju also held the Sogdian cities.

units.note: 阿姆河上游的巴克特里亚（希腊—巴克特里亚王国），城郭林立而兵弱，前130 年前后臣属西迁的大月氏。
units.notee: Bactria on the upper Oxus (the Greco-Bactrian kingdom), rich in walled towns but weak in arms; around 130 BC it fell under the Great Yuezhi.

units.note: 帕提亚帝国，前247 年立国，东境达木鹿（马雷），地方数千里。前115 年前后汉使至安息，安息以大鸟卵及黎轩善眩人献汉。97 年班超遣甘英出使大秦，至安息西界条支海滨而还。
units.notee: The Parthian empire, founded in 247 BC, whose eastern frontier reached Merv (modern Mary); its land stretched thousands of li. Han envoys reached Parthia around 115 BC, and it sent Han ostrich eggs and conjurors from Lixuan. In AD 97 Ban Chao sent Gan Ying towards Da Qin; he reached the Parthian western frontier at the sea of Tiaozhi and turned back.

units.note: 今阿富汗南部、伊朗东部（锡斯坦、阿拉霍西亚）的国家，《汉书》称其地暑热、出狮子犀牛，去长安万二千二百里；1 世纪归贵霜。
units.notee: A state of southern Afghanistan and eastern Iran (Sistan and Arachosia) which the Han shu describes as hot, with lions and rhinoceroses, 12,200 li from Chang'an; it passed to the Kushans in the 1st century.

units.note: 今喀布尔河流域至克什米尔一带，塞种南下所建之国。武帝以后屡杀汉使，成帝时汉绝之。1 世纪后半为贵霜所并。
units.notee: The lands from the Kabul valley to Kashmir, ruled by Saka who had come south. It repeatedly killed Han envoys after Emperor Wu's time and Han broke off relations under Emperor Cheng. It was absorbed by the Kushans in the later 1st century.
